news_mentions.headline: WR Brandon Aiyuk meets with 49ers, 'back to 100 percent' as he seeks reinstatement
news_mentions.description: Brandon Aiyuk has submitted his paperwork to the NFL to get back, and he arrived alongside new agent Drew Rosenhaus for a meeting Friday afternoon at the team’s business offices, which are near the team facility at Levi’s Stadium.
news_mentions.body_text: santa clara calif the nfl has told disgruntled receiver brandon aiyuk that he needs to repay the san francisco 49ers about 13 million he previously received in bonuses as he tries to get reinstated to the team s roster aiyuk has submitted his paperwork to the nfl to get back and he arrived alongside new agent drew rosenhaus for a meeting friday afternoon at the team s business offices which are near the team facility at levi s stadium brandon is here to meet with the team fortunately he s feeling good physically he s healthy he s ready to get back to work rosenhaus said i don t really have any comment about where he s going to play we ll keep that between us and the niners but obviously we re here with all the right intentions a person with knowledge of the situation said the league sent aiyuk and the nfl players association a letter thursday saying that he owes the 49ers the money based on bonuses he was paid after signing a four year 120 million extension just before the start of the 2024 season the person spoke on condition of anonymity because the letter was not released aiyuk did not address the financial issues as he arrived for the meeting i m feeling great feeling healthy long recovery process long rehab process aiyuk said but i m back to 100 percent and looking to get reinstated into the national football league the meeting lasted about an hour and rosenhaus declined to share details to be continued he said coach kyle shanahan said he would have no role in the meeting and didn t care at all what happens saying that he has moved on from aiyuk and the situation isn t a distraction at all it s been over for our football team for a long time shanahan said i don t hear much except questions about it today but it s not too big of a deal for me to answer the ringer first reported that the niners were seeking the money back from aiyuk san francisco general manager john lynch told the team s flagship radio station knbr on thursday that it was a unique situation that the team was trying to work through my job is to look out for the best interests of the 49ers and as such in this particular situation we re working with the nfl management council to navigate through kind of a different situation lynch said it s fluid i m going to kind of leave it at that because i ve been recommended to do so and i think it s the right thing to do we ll look for a pathway for both sides here that works aiyuk hasn t played a game in more than two years since going down with a knee injury in october 2024 and has been on the reserve left squad list after leaving the niners late last season he fired agent ryan williams during his long running dispute with the 49ers and was without representation until he recently hired rosenhaus aiyuk will remain under contract with the 49ers after he is reinstated by the nfl lynch previously has said he doesn t expect aiyuk to play for the niners again the 49ers previously voided 27 million guaranteed in aiyuk s contract for 2026 for failing to participate in meetings and other team activities last summer when he was rehabilitating his knee injury aiyuk signed the big extension just before the start of the 2024 season following a lengthy contract hold in that kept him out of training camp he was coming off a 2023 season when he had 75 catches for 1 342 yards and seven touchdowns and was a second team all pro aiyuk had only 25 catches for 374 yards in seven games in 2024 before getting injured the 28 year old has 294 catches for 4 305 yards and 25 tds since being drafted in the first round in 2020 copyright associated press 2026

news_mentions.headline: Bengals' Joe Burrow enjoying Madrid's museums, feeling like ‘normal person’ ahead of Madrid game
news_mentions.description: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the NFL.
news_mentions.body_text: madrid cincinnati bengals quarterback joe burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the nfl burrow and the bengals are in madrid to take on the atlanta falcons on sunday looking to win their fourth straight game and move to 6 2 in the afc north the trip is not only about football for burrow though he was not yet with the bengals when the team played its first two games abroad in 2016 and 2019 in london this is somewhere that i ve always wanted to go he said friday and so to be able to do it while doing what i love playing football is really a dream come true for me burrow said he was recognized by a group of americans studying abroad while walking around the spanish capital but was enjoying a bit of anonymity on the streets of madrid i usually expect to go pretty incognito and not have anybody recognize me he said it s a little bit more than that but i love being out here because i can feel like a normal person for a little while art connoisseur europe was also allowing burrow to enjoy one of his passions art i went to museo del prado on wednesday that was cool burrow said of spain s renowned art museum and the plan for his half day off on friday was to go find more art in madrid i d like to go see some more museums and go to an art gallery do a little shopping but we ll see he said fashion change shopping in madrid could also be an attractive option for burrow who s been known for his interest in fashion and bold pregame outfits and it could be good timing for him as the bengals quarterback said he has been going through a style change i ve tried to elevate my looks a little bit recently he said for a couple of years there i was full streetwear and i started out going suits on gameday every day and didn t really feel like that was me so i switched it up to full streetwear and that might have been an overcorrection in my creative mind i m finding a happy medium now spanish sports knowledge burrow said he grew up watching soccer and lamented not being able to see one of the two spanish powerhouses play while he was in spain i ve followed international sports for a long time followed real madrid for a long time watched barcelona play real madrid a lot he said played with both of those teams on fifa a lot when i was a kid and loved watching soccer my whole life really so i wish they played while we were here at their home stadium so we could go unfortunately that s not gonna happen but hopefully one day i can make it putting on a show burrow said the bengals explosive and dynamic offense will be fun to watch at real madrid s santiago bernabeu stadium he said he was excited about being the nfl s main attraction sunday morning in the united states i love the only game on tv on sunday morning when people back home wake up and i love showcasing our talents abroad and trying to bring attention to what we do he said offensive line praise burrow threw for five touchdowns and ran for another in overtime as the bengals rallied to defeat the tennessee titans 43 36 last sunday we re completing a lot of passes right now our offensive line is protecting great i think this is the best that that group has played since i ve been here which is really exciting to see he said and you know a lot of our young players are getting better and better and we have the right guys who attack every day with the intent to be better than the day before and i think that is so valuable in this sport super bowl contenders burrow said the bengals still have more to prove before deserving to be considered super bowl contenders i don t think we deserve it yet he said we haven t done enough there s still a lot of season left we certainly have to be a lot better than we have been if we want to be that team at the end of the year winning the super bowl we certainly can we have the capability to do it but right now we aren t there no fast food for zac taylor bengals coach zac taylor joked that he wouldn t really accept anyone going for american fast food while in madrid i ve judged a couple people he said now my kids might be opting for that if you re under 14 years old yes if not i will judge you greatly wide receiver ja 39 marr chase was quick to say friday that he wasn t one of those going for fast food but he did say he missed his chef he also said he was recognized maybe twice on the streets of madrid on thursday defensive tackle dexter lawrence said he missed his bed copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Bengals vs. Falcons: Three must-know storylines for NFL Week 9 Madrid game
news_mentions.description: Does Atlanta excel in an area that could frustrate Joe Burrow? Will Bijan Robinson provide another sparkling performance in the spotlight? Jeremy Bergman provides three must-know storylines for Sunday's Bengals-Falcons game in Madrid.
news_mentions.body_text: this past summer spain sent its top footballers to the united states for a showcase of superior skill interplay and resolve the result la roja lifted its second world cup trophy campeones del mundo this sunday the nfl returns the favor in a way for the second time in as many years madrid is hosting a regular season nfl game but unlike last year s contest which featured a backup quarterback for washington and a dipping dolphins side this installment showcases two teams at near full strength with explosive ability and eyes on the postseason joe cool is on a heater for cincinnati one week removed from a maximalist six touchdown three interception outing in the bengals overtime victory over the lowly titans a win in madrid would bring cincy into a tie with the steelers atop the afc north ahead of their week 10 prime time matchup a 6 2 record would be the bengals best start since 2015 when they opened the season at 8 0 standing in their way the erratic falcons it s hard to get a grip on what the dirty birds are halfway through the season despite the sub 500 record atlanta is squarely in the nfc south race but you could say the same of any club in the uninspiring division including the buccaneers who shut out the falcons last sunday in a tampa typhoon without completing a pass the same falcons team that whooped up the packers in lambeau and handed the 49ers their only loss to date make it make sense that s a lesson for the host spaniards in the nfl any team can win on any given domingo when the bengals and falcons meet at the bernabeu on sunday in a uni matchup so bold it would make pedro almodovar blush expect the unexpected oh and unlike in that brutal world cup final against argentina expect scoring and lots of it three must know storylines 1 is there any slowing down cincy s offense the bengals have scored 78 points in the six quarters and change since a scoreless first half coming out of the bye in baltimore will their offensive onslaught continue in spain joe burrow paces the nfl in most notable passing stats 73 0 completion percentage 302 1 passing ypg 20 tds only four players in the super bowl era have ever led the league in all three of those categories in a season drew brees 2011 tom brady 2007 kurt warner 2001 and ken stabler 1976 it helps of course to have the nfl s top receiving tandem on your side burrow s passer ratings when targeting tee higgins 132 3 and ja 39 marr chase 113 6 each rank in the top five among qb wr tandems in the nfl it s a pick your poison deal for opposing defenses how will atlanta fare possibly quite well burrow might have the highest success rate on downfield passes in the next gen stats era since 2016 but the falcons are feisty 10 yards past the line of scrimmage they ve allowed 2 0 yards of separation on downfield targets the second lowest mark in the nfl and have forced a tight window on 34 8 of those targets the second highest rate plus atlanta is one of two defenses yet to allow a td on a deep pass 20 air yards this season the falcons are a turnover happy bunch as well logging at least one takeaway in seven of eight games including four against brock purdy s then unbeaten 49ers if atlanta can force burrow into some of the same mistakes he made against tennessee perhaps the bengals can be tamed through the air one thing s for sure unlike the falcons last opponent cincinnati will complete at least one pass right 2 another big day for bijan in a solo window no one in the nfl performs better in prime time than bijan robinson a 3 30 local time start in madrid isn t quite like playing under the sunday night lights but it is an exclusive tv window for robinson and the falcons which could mean a showcase for the show stopper the nfl s leading rusher has paced atlanta s fifth ranked run game at one point producing three straight gems in prime time see 478 total yards against green bay new orleans and baltimore in weeks 3 5 robinson has slowed over the last three weeks though the falcons ground game was the only thing even moderately functional in the rain soaked loss at tampa with michael penix throwing four picks is this international stage the perfect platform for a bijan bounce back cincy revamped its defensive front in the offseason and it has paid dividends overall the bengals have stuffed 31 7 of outside zone runs the highest rate in the nfl and a good trend against robinson who averages an nfl best 6 5 yards per carry on outside zone runs with a 53 2 success rate plus though robinson is a great tackle breaker averaging 4 3 yards per carry on runs where he is hit at or behind the line of scrimmage the best rate through eight games by anyone since 2018 the bengals tend not to allow such big gains they ve yielded 0 7 yards per carry second fewest when they ve hit the runner at or behind the line and their 24 5 stuff rate on designed runs is the highest in the nfl an acquaintance of real madrid and france star striker kylian mbappe robinson can only hope that in dexter lawrence and the bengals front he is not like mbappe running into the spanish backline bound for a shutout 3 an international brotherhood in this seventh international matchup of the nfl s historic nine game slate in 2026 a unique meeting is set to take place when the bengals offense faces the falcons defense cincinnati starting running back chase brown and atlanta defensive back sydney brown are set to square off against one another for the second time a battle of twin brothers on foreign soil the european encounter won t feel too strange though after all the browns journey to this moment has been an international one born in london ontario canada the brothers made their entry into the united states in high school when they relocated to bradenton florida from there sydney attended the university of illinois while chase initially went to western michigan before rejoining his brother for four seasons on the fighting illini sydney was a third round pick of philadelphia in 2023 while chase went to cincinnati in the fifth the brothers first played one another in 2024 when sydney s eagles stomped chase s bengals 37 17 in the game chase found the end zone while sydney logged three defensive snaps now the browns will meet again this time across the ocean from their homelands original and adopted chase is coming off his most productive game in what has been a slow start to the season 101 scrimmage yards versus tennessee through eight contests in his first year in atlanta sydney has logged 28 tackles one tfl a pass defensed and a forced fumble perhaps before they presumably meet to exchange jerseys after the game the brothers brown sons of ontario will collide in the middle of madrid s famed bernabeu hermano a hermano

news_mentions.headline: Ravens complete trade for Cardinals' Jacoby Brissett; deal terms revealed
news_mentions.description: The Arizona Cardinals have finalized a trade to send quarterback Jacoby Brissett to the Baltimore Ravens, the teams announced Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: the arizona cardinals have finalized a trade to send quarterback jacoby brissett to the baltimore ravens the teams announced friday baltimore is sending arizona a 2027 fourth round pick and 2028 seventh rounder in exchange for brissett and a 2027 fifth round selection nfl network s ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported the cardinals also paid more than half of brissett s remaining 2026 salary as part of the swap per rapoport the trade was initially reported on wednesday with the caveat that it would be finalized later in the week which has come to fruition cardinals head coach mike lafleur spoke to reporters on wednesday and stated he would let the process play out before confirming now the parties have come to terms in the aftermath of the ravens losing to the jacksonville jaguars on thursday night marking the third time in as many games baltimore had a different starting quarterback and its fourth consecutive loss undrafted free agent joe fagnano started against jacksonville after franchise qb lamar jackson started week 8 and injured his thumb on his first play back from missing time with an ankle injury in jackson s stead tyler huntley filled in as the starter but after relieving jackson against the buffalo bills huntley suffered a turf toe injury that has ended his season jackson meanwhile is on injured reserve and out indefinitely now the ravens winding road turns to brissett who presumably will start in week 10 against the los angeles chargers on monday night football brissett began this season his 11th in the nfl as arizona s qb1 he was benched following eight starts in favor of gardner minshew and shortly thereafter his trade to baltimore was reported so far in 2026 brissett has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 touchdowns and seven interceptions baltimore stands as his seventh nfl team new england patriots indianapolis colts miami dolphins cleveland browns washington commanders cardinals and will become the sixth for which he s started a game the ravens will look to rescue what s fast becoming a lost season as they owned a 12 playoff probability following thursday s defeat unfortunately for those odds brissett hasn t started a game for a playoff team since his rookie season of 2016 with the patriots the cardinals meanwhile will march forward with minshew starting and rookie carson beck in reserve and perhaps getting a shot later as lafleur s team looks to stay competitive and more importantly build for the future

news_mentions.headline: Minkah Fitzpatrick clarifies 'Jets being Jets' comments: 'I know what I said'
news_mentions.description: New York Jets safety Minkah Fitzpatrick has clarified postgame comments that rankled Gang Green fans.
news_mentions.body_text: new york jets safety minkah fitzpatrick has clarified postgame comments that rankled gang green fans following sunday s collapse against the las vegas raiders fitzpatrick said the defensive mistakes were the jets being jets a statement that fed into the same ol jets notion the new york pr team quickly made it known that fitzpatrick meant to say jets beating jets on thursday he had the chance to correct the issue for himself it hasn t really caused any stir within this locker room fitzpatrick said via the new york post that s the most important thing everyone in this locker room knew what i was talking about if you look at the context of what i said if you look at what i ve been saying all season we ve been addressing jets not beating jets or jets beating jets everyone in this locker room knows exactly what i said what i was trying to communicate and in my opinion that s all that matters fitzpatrick said he wasn t aware of the verbal mix up until jets pr told him the 29 year old added that he s moved well past that as new york prepares to take on the kansas city chiefs i know what i said fitzpatrick said it doesn t matter we re playing kansas city this week this locker room needs to focus on winning right now and not something that i might have not said or something i might have done our focus and objective now is to win and not focus on should ve would ve could ve new york has lost three straight games for the second time in 2026 also weeks 2 4 while gang green has scored 58 points since week 7 tied for eighth in the nfl they have zero wins to show for it one of two teams with 50 points and zero wins since week 7 titans the jets have had at least 25 points per game and 400 total yards per game in a two game span with two straight losses the first time they ve hit that feat since weeks 11 12 1996 finished 1 15 that season

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs receiver Rashee Rice files for bankruptcy over debts from crash, alleged assault
news_mentions.description: Chiefs receiver Rashee Rice has filed for bankruptcy, claiming $3.5M in debts, most of it connected to civil litigation involving his high-speed crash in Texas and allegations of assault by a former girlfriend.
news_mentions.body_text: dallas kansas city chiefs receiver rashee rice has filed for bankruptcy claiming 3 5 million in debts most of it connected to civil litigation involving his high speed crash in texas and allegations of assault by a former girlfriend the filing made wednesday in texas lists 677 054 in personal assets including 421 825 in what is listed as deferred compensation rice is in the final year of a four year rookie contract with a total value of 6 5 million and a 2026 base salary of 1 6 million rice s largest debtor is owed 979 837 as part of a settlement for his role in the 2024 crash in dallas that left multiple people injured and led to a six game suspension by the nfl the 26 year old is disputing potential debts in ongoing civil cases including a combined 700 000 in lawsuits filed by crash victims and another 200 000 from the ex girlfriend who alleged he assaulted her multiple times from 2023 25 the league did not punish rice over the assault allegations rice was was sentenced to 30 days in jail and five years probation over the crash he pleaded guilty to third degree felony charges of collision involving serious bodily injury and racing on a highway causing bodily injury rice served another 30 days in jail this year for violating his probation by testing positive for marijuana the former smu player has 20 catches for 243 yards and two touchdowns this season rice had 938 yards receiving and seven touchdowns as a rookie in 2023 when the chiefs won the super bowl copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Eagles QB Joe Milton prepares for first start: NFL is about 'being ready when your name is called'
news_mentions.description: Joe Milton has never made an official start. Sunday, the former sixth-round pick will get his shot when the Philadelphia Eagles host the New York Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: joe milton has never made an official start sunday the former sixth round pick will get his shot when the philadelphia eagles host the new york giants milton said thursday that throughout his career as a backup he s been preparing for this chance i was just pretty much going through the plays going through the week like i was a starter or like i was playing and just being ready milton said via the philadelphia inquirer and that s what the nfl is about just being ready when your name is called and just preparing for those moments milton entered the league with the patriots and flashed athleticism during preseason action in week 18 2024 drake maye took the start but milton played the majority of the contest completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and rushing for another score last year he spent the season with dallas appearing in five games milton s last appearance was week 18 2025 for the cowboys when he played the entire second half versus the giants with dak prescott resting 7 13 73 pass yards one int 43 rush yards milton spent the offseason in dallas and while he showed promise again in preseason action the cowboys chose sam howell as prescott s backup milton signed to the dallas practice squad where the eagles plucked him on oct 16 after jalen hurts was placed on injured reserve due to blood clots milton was asked thursday how much of the eagles playbook he knows shoot whatever s in this week he said laughing milton is taking over for tanner mckee who has started the past three weeks the eagles offense has been a slog for most of the season during its six game skid since week 3 philly has been outgained by 889 yards worst in the nfl the hope is that milton can at least provide some pop to the limp unit he has averaged 10 2 air yards attempt since 2024 per next gen stats second most min 50 attempts both of milton s two career pass tds came on deep passes 20 air yds mckee told reporters he understood why he was benched and has been trying to help milton prepare he hasn t been here the whole time with training camp and some of those plays and so just talking to him about different reads different footwork things that we ve had a little more time on task doing here mckee said and so it s been great just communicating with him things that i ve seen in the past things that we ve learned from jalen or that offensive coordinator sean mannion has communicated in the past or things that we can reiterate to kind of slow his thinking down so he can just be free and be able to play like the great athlete he is the eagles hope that great athlete can wake up an offense that has struggled all season philly has gone three and out on 34 1 percent of drives the highest rate in the nfl and the highest in a season since the 2014 raiders 35 9 pct finished 3 13 the giants defense has forced a three and out on 32 9 percent of drives best in the nfl the eagles and giants kick off from lincoln financial field on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Ravens' play 'not acceptable' in latest blowout loss to Jaguars
news_mentions.description: The Baltimore Ravens lost their fourth straight contest, and third consecutive by 20-plus points.
news_mentions.body_text: it s getting ugly in baltimore the ravens got shellacked thursday night in a rain soaked 33 10 loss to the jacksonville jaguars it marked the first time in franchise history that baltimore haslost by 20 plus points in three consecutive games obviously it s a tough situation for our guys but i just told them there s no excuses there s no whatever we don t have this guy we don t have that guy coach jesse minter said after the loss the defense was out there it felt like the whole half i thought they battled and fought and did a decent job in the second half but obviously the results are not acceptable for us and what we re after losing quarterbacks lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury forced the ravens to start undrafted rookie joe fagnano on a short week the results were what you d expect the qb completed 10 of 18 passes for 60 yards threw two interceptions and took one sack the ravens rarely gave the rookie a chance to rip it and he didn t take it on the precious few early opportunities baltimore tried to lean on the ground game using derrick henry in the wildcat and copious amounts of misdirection you can dress up a ham sandwich with any number of accoutrements as you d like it s still a ham sandwich baltimore was held to 227 total yards and 10 first downs going 4 of 14 on third down and turning it over three times henry was slowed to 57 yards on 17 carries the soaked locals expressed their displeasure with loud halloween themed interjections before heading home early they have every right to boo or do whatever they want to do tight end mark andrews said obviously we re not used to this type of outcome it s not acceptable the lame duck offense will get the headlines but minter s defense has been among the most disappointing units in the entire nfl despite sporting pro bowl players at every level baltimore s d has been ripped up allowing 30 plus points in three straight games guys are frustrated defensive lineman calais campbell said but you got to take some pride in your work and you got to figure out a way at this point in time it s draw a line in the sand and decide where we go from here the offense not staying on the field surely has something to do with a defense that has morphed into a sieve the counter however is the opening drive a seven play touchdown march by the jags on thursday night on which the defense offered little resistance minter s defense has been average to below in nearly every statistical category this season thursday night when it was clear the offense would struggle with a backup qb in poor conditions the defense needed to carry the day previous iterations in baltimore would have instead the ravens broke it wasn t good enough we ve got to be better a clearly frustrated henry said it was the same story it wasn t good enough we ve got to be better with four straight losses sending them to 4 5 before a week 10 date with the current winless los angeles chargers they need to get a whole lot better fast to have any chance at saving the season

news_mentions.headline: Jaguars-Ravens on 'Thursday Night Football': What We Learned from Jacksonville's 33-10 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Grant Gordon breaks down Jacksonville's road rout of the undermanned Ravens on Thursday night.
news_mentions.body_text: just in case you didn t know these jags are legit making their prime time season debut on thursday night the jaguars took care of business and reminded viewers or perhaps notified them for the first time that they are a very legitimate championship contender whether that s simply to retain their afc south crown which seems like almost a chip shot at this point or to make some very real noise in the postseason will remain to be seen this rainy evening was hardly some beautiful exhibition of football glory but aside from a few snafus the jaguars did what they ve been doing all season by blowing out another opponent coming off a 42 7 savaging of the colts that stands as the largest win in the league so far jacksonville had three wins in 2026 by 24 plus points no other team owns more than one and the jaguars came one point short of another thursday night one can argue this wasn t a fair fight the ravens started a rookie undrafted free agent at quarterback after all but eight games into the season we can t dock a team for simply taking care of business we need to laud them in the any given sunday atmosphere of the nfl it s impressive when a good team does what it s supposed to jacksonville had its stumble in week 6 with its loss to a disappointing texans squad but thursday served as a microcosm of the jaguars year so far trevor lawrence is playing mvp caliber ball using an assortment of talented skill position options to aplomb all while the defense and special teams play terrifically as well pomp and circumstance have hardly been prevalent but lopsided wins have thursday night showed these jaguars are ready for prime time and long overdue for recognition as an nfl heavyweight ravens are reeling it s pouring down in baltimore the rain the boos the losses they were all coming down on thursday night as baltimore lost its fourth in a row it was no doubt an uphill climb trying to topple one of the afc s best with an undrafted free agent quarterback joe fagnano under center it s just not that simple though baltimore had five accepted penalties for 31 yards in the first half to set a horrible tone the offensive game plan was clearly to milk the clock get creative and use smoke and mirrors to help fagnano find his way derrick henry took some snaps at quarterback attempted a pass and there was plenty of trickery in the backfield but it played out like a plan to lose by a slimmer margin rather than trying to go out swinging looking for a win fagnano attempted one pass all night of more than 10 yards as the offense drew boos and gained little baltimore s defense rookie head coach jesse minter s calling card hardly stood up to the occasion continuing a campaign in which it s been a massive letdown baltimore allowed seven scoring drives the injuries to lamar jackson and tyler huntley are overwhelming the offensive line has been ravaged by injuries as well heck kicker tyler loop is on injured reserve too veteran quarterback jacoby brissett is reportedly joining the fray in the coming days but more than the qb position needs saving here though brissett should open up the playbook more than it was on thursday he hasn t started a game for a team that made the playoffs since his 2016 rookie season with the patriots minter was tasked with leading a super bowl contender to turn the corner and those best aspirations are getting washed away in a hurry jaguars d tears up ravens the no 2 defense in points allowed heading into week 9 the jaguars shut down the ravens offense allowing three points on baltimore s first drive and nothing for the next nine possessions until justice hill broke loose for a 65 yard touchdown run baltimore had just 227 yards of offense 10 first downs and was 4 of 14 on third down the basic stats and arithmetic were ugly jacksonville racked up three takeaways an interception by montaric brown another pick by jourdan lewis and a fumble recovery on a kickoff return despite losing defensive tackle davon hamilton for the season earlier in the week the no 1 rushing defense held the line against derrick henry confining him to 57 yards on 17 carries the pass rush has been problematic for the jags and it wasn t great on thursday generating a 30 pressure rate but it really made no matter jacksonville has now won four games in which it s held an opponent to 10 points or less trevor just keeps getting it done with time winding down chants of trev er lore ence broke out at m t bank stadium jaguars fans had taken over with disgruntled ravens fans leaving for drier and less frustrating ground lawrence finished the evening completing 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards and a 50 yard touchdown to parker washington it s anything but a flashy stat line but this was an ugly night weather wise and the ravens did their best to slow play things lawrence s mvp candidacy remains alive he s hardly the front runner but he s the face and symbol of an ascending afc power there isn t all that much sizzle but there s plenty of substance this wasn t a game for big fantasy pleasing numbers just results that really matter lawrence who hasn t thrown an interception in 10 quarters completed throws to eight pass catchers and finished with a 105 0 passer rating his qb rating sits at a league high 111 7 after thursday just ahead of joe burrow 111 6 lawrence is getting it done in splendid if not spectacular fashion and the jags are following his lead which is currently a very healthy advantage in the afc south life without lamar it s never easy playing without your starting quarterback much less when it s lamar jackson a transcendent talent and two time ap nfl most valuable player unfortunately it s not been an uncommon occurrence having returned from an ankle sprain last week only to be lost likely for the season with a thumb injury the ravens have to soldier forward without him and backup tyler huntley who is out for the season thursday dropped baltimore s record to 7 14 without jackson since he took over the starting reins for the club in 2018 now with jackson on injured reserve and his season all but officially over his future with the franchise has become a prevailing topic and it won t cease being a discussion point anytime soon the ravens and jackson couldn t work out an extension this offseason and the final year of his current contract is 2027 his age 30 season and one in which his contract poses an 84 34 million cap hit before any of that is resolved the ravens still have another nine games in the regular season over the last four in which jackson played one snap total derrick henry has rushed for less than 60 yards in each game there is a domino effect unsurprisingly without jackson the future beyond this year is unclear and the rest of this one is increasingly murky next gen stats insight for jaguars ravens via nfl pro ravens qb joe fagnano was 0 for 1 on downfield passes 10 plus air yards trevor lawrence completed eight of his 10 downfield attempts for 193 yards and a touchdown against the ravens his most downfield passing yards in a game and second highest downfield completion rate 80 of the season nfl research derrick henry was held to 57 yards on thursday but he improved to 13 707 in his career surpassing hall of famers jerome bettis 13 662 yards ninth place all time and ladainian tomlinson 13 684 eighth to move into seventh place on all time in rushing yards

news_mentions.headline: Vikings to start Carson Wentz vs. Bills on Monday with Kyler Murray battling hamstring injury
news_mentions.description: The Minnesota Vikings will start quarterback Carson Wentz on Monday against the Buffalo Bills with Kyler Murray dealing with a hamstring injury, head coach Kevin O'Connell announced on Thursday.
news_mentions.body_text: a change is coming at quarterback for the vikings in week 9 carson wentz will start for minnesota in monday night s contest against the buffalo bills head coach kevin o connell told reporters on thursday kyler murray will miss the game due to a hamstring injury and is considered week to week per o connell max brosmer will assume backup duties behind wentz on monday o connell added the starting lineup swap doesn t come as a surprise after o connell told reporters on monday that murray was dealing with a sore hamstring following their week 8 loss to the detroit lions murray has had a challenging start to the 2026 season his first in minnesota with murray behind center for the majority of the season the vikings offense has struggled mightily ranking 29th in yards gained per game 31st in passing and 27th in points scored per contest 20 despite these issues the vikings own a 6 1 record entering week 9 thanks to the performance of an elite defense that ranks second in yards per game allowed and first in points per game allowed 13 3 minnesota s aggressive attacking defense has harassed opposing quarterbacks all season blitzing at a league high rate of 73 1 percent 30 5 percentage points higher than the next closest team and generating a qb pressure rate of 45 8 percent also the best in the nfl wentz certainly benefited from this defensive support in his two appearances one start earlier this season after murray suffered a concussion in the regular season opener the vikings won both games despite wentz finishing short of 150 passing yards in each contest in his two games played in 2026 the 33 year old quarterback has completed 23 of 39 passes for 276 yards and three touchdowns as o connell described it wentz s insertion into the starting lineup is only a temporary measure but if he succeeds at a rate higher than what vikings fans have begrudgingly come to accept from their team this season don t be surprised if a qb controversy arises in the near future

news_mentions.headline: NFL, USAA unveil 32 nominees for 2026 Salute to Service Award
news_mentions.description: The NFL and USAA, an official NFL Salute to Service partner, today announced the 32 nominees for the 2026 Salute to Service Award presented by USAA.
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl and usaa an official nfl salute to service partner today announced the 32 nominees for the 2026 salute to service award presented by usaa representing all 32 nfl clubs this year s nominees include players coaches staff and alumni who have demonstrated an exceptional commitment to supporting u s service members veterans and their families now in its 16th year the salute to service award recognizes individuals across the league who go above and beyond to honor empower and connect with the military community this year s nominees support those who serve through partnerships with veteran focused organizations hands on community engagement and other efforts informed by their personal connections to military service these nominees exemplify a commitment to something bigger than the game said anna isaacson senior vice president of social responsibility at the nfl through their year round support for service members veterans and their families they show how the nfl community can turn gratitude into action in communities across the country we are proud to recognize these individuals alongside usaa and share their stories with fans the salute to service award is an incredible opportunity each season for usaa and the nfl to recognize those who engage in exceptional efforts to show appreciation for the military community particularly this year as our nation celebrates 250 years said major general retired bob whittle senior vice president and head of military affairs at usaa we are proud to celebrate these nominees and their exceptional contributions towards honoring and supporting our military and we hope they encourage fans everywhere to do the same fans can vote for their favorite nominee at nfl com salutefanvote with one vote per nominee per day from now through monday november 30 2026 at 11 59 p m et fan voting will help determine the award s three finalists who will be announced in january 2027 the award recipient will be recognized at nfl honors the league s annual primetime awards special during the week of super bowl lxi in los angeles san francisco 49ers running back christian mccaffrey received the 2025 salute to service award through the christian mccaffrey foundation s 23 and troops initiative launched in 2021 he helps veterans particularly those in the special operations community access athlete level care for their mental and physical well being his foundation has invested nearly 700 000 in military support including funding for trauma healing through reboot recovery and personalized medical care through resilience code as the 2025 salute to service award recipient mccaffrey will join the salute to service award panel that will select the 2026 award recipient additional judges include chad hennings air force academy graduate and three time super bowl champion donnie edwards 2019 salute to service award recipient nfl legend bob whittle usaa senior vice president and head of military affairs and christine dorfler nfl chief financial officer and u s army veteran as the award s presenting sponsor usaa a leading provider of insurance and banking and financial services to u s military members veterans and their families will contribute 25 000 in the recipient s name to official aid societies representing all u s military branches the nfl foundation will match usaa s contribution by donating an additional 25 000 to the recipient s military nonprofit charity of choice through salute to service usaa the nfl and its 32 clubs honor empower and connect with service members veterans and their families year round during weeks 9 11 of the regular season clubs will recognize the military community through on field branding military appreciation activities and other game day events news_mentions.headline: Bill Belichick again is among five coaching candidates for Pro Football Hall of Fame
news_mentions.description: Tom Coughlin, Mike Holmgren, Dan Reeves and Mike Shanahan join Bill Belichick in the Coach category for possible election into the Hall’s Class of 2027.
news_mentions.body_text: bill belichick again is among five coaching candidates for the pro football hall of fame tom coughlin mike holmgren dan reeves and mike shanahan join belichick in the coach category for possible election into the hall s class of 2027 the list was announced thursday by the canton ohio based pro football hall of fame members of the hall s coaching subcommittee made their selections from an original field of 14 nominees the subcommittee will select one candidate to be considered when the hall s selection committee determines a new class of enshrinees in early 2027 all five reached this stage last year when belichick advanced in the process but the six time super bowl champion head coach was not elected in his first year of eligibility belichick s snub was criticized intensely around the nfl if he s not a first ballot hall of famer there s really no coach that should ever be a first ballot hall of famer which is completely ridiculous because people deserve it he s incredible tom brady said belichick and brady won six super bowls with the new england patriots belichick also won two as a defensive assistant coach with the new york giants belichick s career included a sign stealing scandal dubbed spygate in the 2007 season he was fined 500 000 after the team was caught filming defensive signals from the new york jets during a game belichick s final season in new england was 2023 he s in his second season coaching in college at north carolina coughlin won two super bowls with the giants beating belichick brady and the patriots both times he was 182 157 in 20 seasons with the giants and jacksonville jaguars coughlin also won a title with giants as an assistant coach holmgren led the green bay packers to one super bowl title and was 174 122 including postseason in 17 seasons with the packers and seattle seahawks he also won two super bowls as an assistant with the san francisco 49ers reeves was 201 174 2 in 23 seasons with the denver broncos giants and atlanta falcons he led the broncos to the super bowl three times and the falcons once going 0 4 reeves won a title as an assistant with the dallas cowboys shanahan won back to back super bowls with denver and was 178 144 in 20 seasons with the broncos and washington he also won a title with the 49ers as an assistant coach on wednesday the hall of fame announced the five contributors who have advanced in the process ralph hay robert kraft virginia mccaskey doug williams and john wooten the final list of 15 candidates will include one contributor one coach and 13 modern era players the group will be reduced to 10 and then seven candidates a 25 person selection committee will be able to vote for six people with 80 of support needed the hall said that would lead to a range of three to seven hall of famers each year with by far the most likely number to get the necessary support being either five or six people the pro football hall of fame s class of 2027 will be announced at nfl honors in los angeles in february and enshrined next august in canton copyright 2026 the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Fox Sports to honor America's veterans with NFL, college football coverage live from West Point, Annapolis ahead of Veterans Day
news_mentions.description: This year, to cap off the country's 250th birthday celebration, Fox Sports is expanding its tradition with special two-day NFL and college football pregame coverage from two of the nation's most-storied military academies.
news_mentions.body_text: fox sports has a long tradition of honoring america s military heroes on veterans day weekend this year to cap off the country s 250th birthday celebration fox sports is expanding its tradition with special two day nfl and college football pregame coverage from two of the nation s most storied military academies fox nfl sunday will air live on nov 8 from the united states military academy at west point and the united states naval academy in annapolis md fox sports will also air its saturday big noon kickoff live on nov 7 from west point fox sports is proud to expand our longstanding tradition of saluting america s military heroes by bringing together two of our most iconic pregame shows for an unprecedented two day tribute from west point and annapolis fox sports ceo and executive producer eric shanks said in a statement there is no more meaningful backdrop than these two storied institutions and we look forward to celebrating america s veterans and the enduring bond between military service and sports across veterans day weekend according to fox sunday s coverage in annapolis will feature the striking backdrop of the academy s iconic bancroft hall and the pride of the brigade of the midshipmen set the stage for a stirring tribute to america s military the nfl also announced on thursday that during weeks 9 11 of the regular season all 32 nfl clubs will recognize the military community through special gameday tributes community events and charitable initiatives that build on the league s year round commitment to those who serve fox s sunday coverage will feature curt menefee terry bradshaw howie long michael strahan rob gronkowski jay glazer charissa thompson charles woodson and julian edelman

news_mentions.headline: Kyle Shanahan admits 49ers explored Jauan Jennings trade, but WR 'pretty happy' in Minnesota
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan on Wednesday discussed his team's pursuit of a deal for veteran receiver Jauan Jennings.
news_mentions.body_text: the san francisco 49ers find themselves in another division title race and in need of some help at receiver naturally the 49ers turned toward a familiar face former niner and current vikings receiver jauan jennings when contemplating potential acquisitions ahead of tuesday s trade deadline as things moved closer toward possibly becoming a reality head coach kyle shanahan was permitted to talk with his former receiver about a potential deal and learned jennings was not interested in a reunion we love jauan we have such a good relationship with jauan and know him really well and we didn t want to do it without talking to him first shanahan explained wednesday when asked about an earlier report on their interest in jennings so we had to agree on some things to at least make it close enough to be able to talk to him then when we got on a facetime with j j it went well it was awesome we talked about a lot of stuff and he ended up saying that he was happy with where he was it wasn t just like a definite no first but he was like man kyle i m pretty happy here and liking stuff and when i heard the way he talked and where we re at i agreed with him so it was a good conversation and something that was possible but that s why it didn t go down a trusted secondary option during his five years spent in san francisco jennings embraced his next professional opportunity with a vikings team that welcomed him in as the third option behind justin jefferson and jordan addison in 2026 on paper the fit made sense jennings reliable production would pair nicely with jefferson addison and an offense that was expected to be propelled by quarterback kyler murray the results haven t matched the expectation minnesota is 6 1 but has earned those victories on the back of its elite defense while the offense has lagged significantly behind unsurprisingly jennings has proven to be irrelevant in the low ceiling offense catching six passes for 54 yards in six games one might believe that would lead jennings to want out but as shanahan discovered jennings seems to be enjoying the vikings success despite his lack of involvement with that door closed the 49ers will have to look elsewhere for help in a position group that already lost ricky pearsall to a season ending knee injury and is still hoping mike evans can return before long from a week 7 achilles injury they look every week to see who you can add week in and week out shanahan said of san francisco s pursuit of an addition at receiver it gets bigger as the trade deadline comes but j j was someone we knew so someone we wanted to talk to if we went through with that and they were willing to do it at the time we wanted to have a conversation with him knowing the guy receivers is something we still are looking into and so is every other position jennings meanwhile will hope minnesota s 31st ranked passing attack can find a rhythm before december

news_mentions.headline: Packers' Josh Jacobs isn't worrying over whether additional allegations will lead to more punishment
news_mentions.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs says he isn’t worrying about the possibility he may have to miss more games due to the release of allegations.
news_mentions.body_text: green bay wis green bay packers running back josh jacobs says he isn t worrying about the possibility he may have to miss more games due to the release of allegations that were made against him years before he pleaded no contest to two misdemeanor charges stemming from a may altercation with his then girlfriend with all the evidence that we have and that they have at this point it s not one of those things where i m sitting back on my hands like ok am i going to play this week jacobs said wednesday it s like i kind of already know what it is so it s like it s really just up to them to make their final decision but i m not worried about feeling like i m going to miss any more time than i already have after spending the first six games of the season on the commissioner s exempt list which prevented him from playing or practicing jacobs has returned to play in the packers last two games the nfl has said its investigation into jacobs is ongoing which means he still could be subject to more discipline from the league jacobs pleaded no contest on sept 10 to charges of battery and criminal damage to property he was arrested may 26 after his then girlfriend said he had thrown her to the ground three days earlier in response to a public records request the hobart lawrence wisconsin police department released records from their investigation friday night that included the accounts of three other women who reported similar allegations from years before lawyers representing jacobs said he has a substantial body of tangible evidence disputing the allegations that surfaced in friday s records release they said those allegations are old are hearsay and easily disproven it really feels like an attack on me and who i am and my character jacobs said wednesday and at the end of the day there s a lot of stuff being said about me that s completely false like completely made up and it s like people just run with it and i can t change that it s just one of those thing where it s like ok all i can do is try to be who i am and try not to let the negative moments change who i am and that was the biggest thing for me throughout this whole process i didn t want to go to a place where i felt like i was closed off and i m angry all the time because of what s going on in my life jacobs lawyers david z chesnoff richard a schonfeld and clarence f duchac said that one of the three women made a claim to the nfl which reviewed it and decided no action was warranted they said jacobs has kept evidence that supports his accounts and the nfl s decision the nfl has declined comment on the lawyers statement after hobart lawrence police released the records that detailed the accounts from the other women nfl spokesman brian mccarthy had said saturday that the league would review these allegations as part of its investigation jacobs arrest followed a may 23 incident in which police officers came to his wisconsin home to investigate a disturbance according to police a woman told them jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground as she was trying to exit a garage door causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground police said they noticed redness on her face and neck and could feel a bump on the back of her head copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Colts HC not limiting Jonathan Taylor's workload amid trade rumors: 'He wants to go win this game'
news_mentions.description: The biggest fish on the Colts' roster is running back Jonathan Taylor, whose name continues to circulate ahead of next week's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: indianapolis launched a fire sale last week sending two key players defensive tackle deforest buckner and guard quenton nelson to nfc title contenders and recouping draft capital while both are big names neither is the biggest fish on the colts roster that title belongs to running back jonathan taylor whose name continues to circulate ahead of next tuesday s trade deadline indianapolis could move him for the right price he s under a recently signed contract extension meaning he ll be under team control with his next employer should the colts trade him he s also still at the peak of his powers as one of the nfl s best running backs the colts aren t interested in solely playing the market though coach shane steichen told reporters wednesday ahead of their week 9 game against the cowboys that he isn t limiting taylor s workload amid trade rumors despite the fact a standard amount of carries could expose him to a greater risk of injury and thus diminished return if the colts trade him i think there s a lot of stuff out there right now but he s on our football team and he s excited for this opportunity to play he wants to go win this game steichen said via the associated press there s a lot of hypotheticals out there on the trade talks right now but he s on our football team to taylor s credit he isn t taking any plays off or letting his mind wander to a possible next destination the running back has explained in detail how he and his colts teammates are approaching the remainder of the season following the firing of general manager chris ballard and beginning steps of an anticipated roster teardown teams are going to look at us even more foaming at the mouth taylor said after indy s week 8 loss in jacksonville your back is against the wall what are you going to do you re going to have to fight your way out of a corner this is not getting nowhere near any easier you ve got to accept that and when you accept that that s just the first step despite the downturn indianapolis isn t shipping out every valuable player the colts received but have not fulfilled receiver josh downs trade request and he played in last sunday s defeat and they have since extended rising star defensive tackle adetomiwa adebawore on a two year deal reportedly worth 35 million but as he approaches his 28th birthday in january taylor isn t quite in the early stages of his career that would make him a guaranteed part of the colts future inspiring trade rumblings for now the colts will continue as constructed until told otherwise by the front office that could change with a phone call in the next week of course but it s all steichen s squad can do amid the uncertainty i think all the guys that are on our football team are getting ready to go play a football game he said those are the conversations i ve had with those guys in the front office that we re going out to try to go win a football game right now that s where we re at

news_mentions.headline: Texans' Will Anderson: Justin Herbert 'playing out of his mind' for winless Chargers
news_mentions.description: Houston's Will Anderson Jr. will face Justin Herbert and the Chargers in Week 9 and is giving standard respect to his upcoming opponent -- even if it's, well, a bit inaccurate.
news_mentions.body_text: we re learning a lesson about how tone can change depending on timing take texans edge rusher will anderson he is part of a houston team that will face justin herbert and the chargers in week 9 and is giving standard respect to his upcoming opponent even if it s well a bit inaccurate he s still a really great quarterback in this league anderson said of herbert on wednesday you talk about a big guy that has a big arm that can run around that can throw the ball deep makes a lot of plays with his legs he s still a very respectable player in this league and we have a ton of respect for them pretty standard fare so far but anderson didn t stop there and that s when things exited reality and ventured elsewhere we know what to expect a little bit but herbert he s playing out of his mind he continued they have a really great solid offensive line as well and some really good running backs that can get downhill that can hit the perimeter it s going to be a good challenge for us anderson could have stopped at we have a ton of respect for them but continued into a fictional realm as a means of avoiding providing bulletin board material those who have watched herbert and the chargers the nfl s only winless team know the quarterback hasn t played well and neither have his teammates one might wonder whether out of his mind meant herbert was playing without the full scope of his faculties his touchdown to interception ratio 5 10 would match such a description perhaps we should just let last week s opponent the los angeles rams quentin lake summarize what has actually occurred he was throwing deli meat out there lake said during an appearance on the st brown podcast he s seeing ghosts i don t know what s going on but we knew we were going to get a couple of interceptions at least one the rams ended up snagging two with lake grabbing the first midway through the first quarter by sliding underneath herbert s intended target for one of the easier takeaways he ll log in his professional career fellow rams defensive back trent mcduffie hauled in the other in a 24 9 win over the chargers look herbert is deeply mired in the roughest stretch of his pro career while playing in an offense that clearly doesn t fit the chargers strengths offensive coordinator mike mcdaniel remains employed in los angeles but for how long remains to be seen if coach jim harbaugh is looking for a fall guy amid this disastrous season mcdaniel makes for an easy mark that s what makes anderson s comments baffling los angeles owns the nfl s 28th ranked offense in yards per game 26th in passing yards per game and 31st in interception rate the operation is a mess and herbert can t stop making things worse at least anderson achieved one goal he didn t give the chargers additional motivational material judging by what s happened up to this point in the season though it s unlikely he ll match the edge rusher s description sunday it might just be part of anderson s grand plan to soften up his next target

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 8 games: Cardinals bench QB Jacoby Brissett vs. Cowboys
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 8 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 8 sunday arizona cardinals quarterback gardner minshew replaced jacoby brissettin the second half of sunday s win over dallas brissett was 10 of 23 for 119 yards and an interception at the time of his benching with arizona trailing 17 3 running back jeremiyah love ankle left early and did not return running back bam knight concussion and wide receiver kendrick bourne ankle were ruled out baltimore ravens quarterback lamar jackson right thumb was ruled out from sunday s game against buffalo jackson needs surgery on his injured thumb and will be placed on injured reserve coach jesse minter said after the game qb tyler huntley was also ruled out and suffered what is thought to be a turf toe injury per espn s adam schefter huntley is expected to undergo an mri on monday schefter reported buffalo bills wide receiver josh palmer hamstring was ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore chicago bears linebackers coach richard smith will not travel with the team to seattle for monday s game against the seahawks due to a health issue the team announced assistant linebackers coach kevin koch will handle lb coach duties per the team cincinnati bengals defensive end cashius howell right wrist and defensive end cedric johnson left ankle were ruled out of sunday s win over tennessee cleveland browns defensive tackle maliek collins elbow did not return to sunday s loss to pittsburgh dallas cowboys tight end jake ferguson ankle was ruled out of sunday s loss to arizona cornerback joey porter ankle did not return while safety caleb downs was evaluated for a concussion and ruled out detroit lions linebacker jack campbell was transported to a local hospital to be evaluated for a neck injury suffered in the second half of sunday s win over minnesota the team announced campbell is resting and will remain in the hospital on sunday night for continued evaluation and monitoring campbell left the field on a stretcher after suffering the injury center cade mays ankle running back jacob saylors neck edge rusher d j wonnum concussion and safety brian branch jets los angeles rams cornerback jaylen watson shoulder was ruled out of sunday s win over the chargers cornerback trent mcduffie back did not return to the game minnesota vikings safety theo jackson quad was ruled out of sunday s loss to detroit philadelphia eagles defensive back michael carter abdomen did not return to sunday night s loss against the commanders tampa bay buccaneers linebacker news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 6 games: Bills S C.J. Gardner-Johnson ejected
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 6 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 6 sunday atlanta falcons linebacker divine deablo arm was ruled out of sunday s loss to chicago linebacker kendal daniels neck was ruled out after he exited the game on a stretcher in the third quarter the falcons later announced that daniels is alert and has movement in his extremities daniels was taken to a local hospital for further evaluation baltimore ravens wide receiver rashod bateman shoulder was ruled out of sunday s loss to cleveland buffalo bills safety c j gardner johnson was ejected in the second quarter of sunday s game after appearing to spit at a raiders player chicago bears offensive lineman jonah jackson hip did not return to sunday s win over atlanta cleveland browns safety grant delpit concussion was ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore dallas cowboys wide receiver kavontae turpin rib was ruled out of sunday s game against the packers lb dee winters ankle did not return against the packers green bay packers cb brandon cisse stinger did not return against the cowboys houston texans safety reed blankenship concussion was ruled out of sunday s win over jacksonville indianapolis colts cornerback sauce gardner calf did not return to sunday s loss to tennessee jacksonville jaguars safety antonio johnson ankle did not return to sunday s loss to houston kansas city chiefs right tackle jaylon moore left sunday s game against the chargers and is in the concussion protocol per the team cornerback christian roland wallace was ejected in the fourth quarter after appearing to throw a punch at a chargers player los angeles chargers wide receiver ladd mcconkey and defensive back deane leonard were ruled out of sunday s game against kansas city after suffering concussions los angeles rams kicker blake grupe who was signed this week to replace harrison mevis suffered a knee injury in the first quarter and was ruled out against the cardinals new england patriots wide receiver romeo doubs shoulder and guard alijah vera tucker hamstring were ruled out of sunday s win over the jets offensive tackle morgan moses ankle and center ben brown knee were also ruled out new orleans saints guard cesar ruiz knee did not return to sunday s win over the giants new york giants cornerback greg newsome concussion was ruled out of sunday s loss to the saints wide receiver darnell mooney neck also did not return new york jets linebacker kiko mauigoa thigh did not return to sunday s loss to new england philadelphia eagles linebacker nolan smith was ruled out after suffering a concussion in the first half of sunday s loss to carolina defensive tackle jordan davis ankle and running back carson steele shoulder were also ruled out tennessee titans safety tony adams ankle did not return to sunday s win over indianapolis

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason
