news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 9 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 2 p m et on thursday nov 5 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday nov 8 why gennaro picked the bengals joe burrow and michael penix are both coming off career days burrow notched a career best six total touchdowns in an overtime win penix threw a career worst four interceptions in a rain soaked loss but i m not here today to talk about either quarterback rather i d like to spotlight a bengals receiver and it isn t the one we usually fawn over yes this is a tee higgins appreciation blurb typically overshadowed by perennial pro bowler ja marr chase higgins currently ranks second in the nfl behind only jaxon smith njigba with 636 receiving yards putting him on pace for nearly 1 800 yards on the season the 6 foot 4 220 pounder has always been a beast at the catch point but he s become a true monster after the catch this season owning a career high rate in missed tackles forced 27 9 per next gen stats in related news nfl research tells me that burrow and higgins comfortably boast the highest passer rating of any qb wr combo in the league min 45 targets at 132 3 of course burrow and chase still rank fifth in that category at 113 6 leading me to the larger point here we ve all been saying cincinnati has two wr1s for years nowadays that almost feels like an undersell the bengals have two of the most frightening offensive weapons in the league at the moment with higgins 10 155 2 and chase 11 141 1 both posting primo stat lines last sunday and this week they draw an atlanta cb group that s been marred by injuries and inconsistency in a potential shootout on the international stage give me the league s best receiving duo why gennaro picked the panthers riding a four game win streak denver has shot to the top of the afc west and yet there are still plenty of reasons to doubt these broncos the offense quite frankly is boring well until bo nix decides to put together a game winning drive and the defense while solid in some of the advanced statistics just hasn t been the shutdown unit of the past two seasons ranking 20th against the pass 25th against the run and 25th on third down yes denver s a perfect 4 0 at home compiling an impressive collection of victories over the jaguars rams seahawks and chiefs but this week s game is in charlotte and away from mile high the broncos have been rather unremarkable beating the also rans chargers cardinals and losing to the contenders chiefs 49ers which brings us to the panthers are they an also ran or a contender honestly it s kind of hard to say despite being below 500 they currently sit atop a dull nfc south and while they opened october with an impressive win over the lions they closed the month with one sided defeats to the buccaneers and packers consequently this feels like a midseason hinge game especially with carolina set to hit the road in three of the next four weeks now it s possible denver s pass rush just overwhelms carolina s battered offensive line and the firing of dc ejiro evero could either spark or spike the panthers defense but with carolina having a few extra days to recuperate and regroup following last week s appearance on thursday night football i envision dave canales rallying his plucky team to a narrow home win over a broncos squad that currently feels far closer to 6 3 than 7 2 why jeremy picked the cowboys it s a matchup of fire sale vs fire everybody the colts and cowboys are entering sunday s game at arguably the lowest points of each of their seasons indy is more focused on the trade deadline than the play between the lines despite what shane steichen has to say dallas is coming off an unthinkable choke job at home against the cardinals casting doubt on whether it can really compete in a limp nfc east something s gotta give jonathan taylor is set up for a big day against dallas the 32nd ranked run defense in the league but the colts rb has recently been corralled by opposing defenses while trade rumors swirl the more defining matchup sunday will be whether indianapolis can slow down dak prescott ceedee lamb and george pickens who can put up yards and points against the colts 30th ranked scoring defense with javonte williams getting good touches against the league s least efficient run defense the cowboys should wrangle the colts on sunday unless their lasso loosens in the second half again why dan picked the chiefs while both teams enter week 9 on a losing streak there are not many games that could offer a better get right environment to the chiefs than a meeting with the jets at home kansas city s offense has taken a step back with injury woes at receiver and defenses bottling up kenneth walker but gang green should offer far less resistance than seattle and denver did in the last two weeks aaron glenn s crew has allowed 30 7 points per game in its three game losing streak second most in the league during that span no team has allowed more epa per dropback over the last two weeks than new york 0 53 and that was against the likes of malik willis and kirk cousins glenn s offense is coming off a season high 33 point performance but geno smith might be without his top weapon garrett wilson who is in the concussion protocol it s been more than two years since the jets won on the road against an above 500 team and it would take a very uninspired performance from patrick mahomes and co to end that skid on sunday editor s update on friday jets coach aaron glenn said garrett wilson will not play in sunday s game why bobby picked the lions miami has played better after its week 6 bye beating the jets and then holding an ill fated double digit halftime lead over the patriots but detroit also seems to be finding its stride after going 2 2 over the first month of the season with the two wins feeling far more contested than the losses the lions have now rattled off three consecutive victories detroit s achilles heel the defense has improved during the winning streak the lions have allowed their three lowest point totals and three lowest yardage totals of the season in the past three contests giving up a per game average of 17 7 points and 305 7 yards since week 5 compared to 31 8 points and 423 8 yards in weeks 1 4 it s a touch dramatic to call a nov 8 game for a 5 2 team a must win but that s how brutal the nfc north is the lions simply can t afford to drop a game against a one win team when they have four tough divisional matchups still to go plus dates with the patriots a resurgent buccaneers club a falcons team that knocked the 49ers off their unbeaten perch and the nfc east leading giants they know that and as the superior squad they ll play like it why brooke picked the saints shedeur sanders is in line to start for the browns with deshaun watson who was playing his best ball since 2020 entering concussion protocol earlier this week the biggest difference with sanders under center appears to be his willingness to stretch the field as his average of 7 1 air yards per target in 2025 trumps watson s 6 7 mark through eight games this season sanders is also working with better receivers than he did a year ago with rookies denzel boston and kc concepcion earning big roles in todd monken s offense none of that will ultimately matter if the run game is dormant as it was last week 34 yards in pittsburgh the saints defense has been anything but great against the run allowing 139 4 rush yards per game 29th in the nfl and giving up north of 100 yards in all but one game in 2026 but i do see this being a get right game for new orleans on all fronts with the saints fresh off the bye changes were made to the run game firing run game coordinator t j paganetti signing rb audric estim 233 and the kicking ranks charlie smyth is expected to handle duties after daniel carlson s release and the entire roster got a little healthier first round receiver jordyn tyson returned to practice and could be a boon if he does indeed make his nfl debut this week for tyler shough opposite chris olave getting kelvin banks back along an o line that has struggled to keep shough clean in the pocket will significantly benefit kellen moore s unit whenever banks returns to game action sanders can smile all he wants but the saints will get the last laugh sunday why jeremy picked the giants in a meeting of former michigan men j j mccarthy and joe milton backups on other franchises in september will renew one of the nfl s fiercest rivalries to kick off november mccarthy will get his second start leading the giants offense while milton on his third team will see his first ever nfl start for philadelphia after being called on to replace an ineffective tanner mckee the g men have played close games under john harbaugh they ve entered the last minute of each of their tilts separated on one score or less save for the rams debacle and this one should be no different even against a beat up eagles side philly historically plays new york well at home the giants have dropped 12 straight at a hostile lincoln financial field and the infusion of milton to the offense could provide a spark for nick sirianni s squad milton is a bomb thrower averaging the second most air yards per attempt since 2024 min 50 attempts in his relief appearances mccarthy has had a similar run of play in his six quarters with big blue helping make malik nabers the reigning offensive player of the month there will be big plays and maybe bigger mistakes made in sunday s game but unlike the injury riddled eagles the 26 giants know how to win tight tussles and should ride the amtrak back to new jersey victorious why jeremy picked the rams sean mcvay will coach the rams in landover on sunday for the first time in front of a home crowd since he left for los angeles in 2017 after three years as washington s oc mcvay s rams made this long trip east in 2020 but that year never happened if you think about it mcvay returns to the nation s capital at a critical juncture with the once super bowl favorites at 4 4 but on a two game winning streak the commanders are also amid a midseason turnaround after a get right win out of the bye over the wounded eagles but jayden daniels and co may be running into a buzzsaw in a rams defense that could return myles garrett who was back at practice this week if the reigning dpoy is in the lineup he will line up alongside three time dpoy aaron donald for the first time since both joined the rams this offseason perhaps it ll be the straw that breaks opponents backs donald has yet to log a sack this season daniels has played carefully since his injury he hasn t thrown a pick this season and washington has just three giveaways on the year the qb may need to let it loose sunday to keep up with matthew stafford and the fourth ranked rams offense this one will be closer than most expect but l a presents a much more difficult task for the commanders than tanner mckee s eagles editor s update on friday nfl network s mike garafolo and ian rapoport reported that myles garrett knee is expected to play on sunday why dan picked the texans when the chargers take the field on sunday it will have been nearly a full month since they last scored a touchdown yes there was a bye week during that stretch but they ve still gone nine full quarters without putting the ball in the end zone scoring just 15 points five field goals in that span in other words woof now the texans have been nearly as disappointing as their week 9 opponent last we saw houston it was being overpowered in overtime by a j j mccarthy led offense to fall to 2 5 demeco ryans squad enjoys a rest advantage though coming off a bye and has done a respectable job of putting points on the board thanks to a reassuring year 4 showing from c j stroud that flies a bit under the radar because of the team s struggles the outlook might be bleak for the texans right now but if they have any hope of salvaging their season they cannot let the chargers win their first game since dec 21 2025 why brooke picked the 49ers the raiders snapped their four game skid with a road victory over the jets parlaying that into two straight ws isn t likely as they head to santa clara to face the 49ers it s true that san francisco struggled big time with turnovers prior to the bye with the offense coughing up eight giveaways in the last three games and christian mccaffrey and mike evans are still dealing with injuries it s also true that these niners have the advantage in most major categories per nfl pro the two exceptions are overall passing efficiency and pressure rate when the raiders offense and 49ers defense share the field enter nick bosa who s in line to play for the first time since sept 20 and deforest buckner whom gm john lynch brought back to san francisco during the break per next gen stats when aligned as a dt buckner recorded four sacks tied for second most at the position 15 pressures tied for 16th six quick pressures tied for ninth and eight quarterback hits tied for fourth through the first seven weeks of the season despite being double teamed 83 times as a pass rusher tied for seventh most among dts in addition he has one missed tackle on 32 tackle attempts tied for the fewest at the position among those with 25 or more attempts buckner s addition should pay dividends for san francisco moving forward beginning sunday against the visiting raiders why brooke picked the patriots the packers and patriots have had the same results every week of the 2026 season and i pray they don t follow suit in week 9 because that would mean a dreaded tie please no these clubs have won four of their last five games significantly improving upon their rocky starts and feature many similar aspects including top 10 defenses the countdown to micah parsons return to game action is on and quarterbacks who aren t afraid to heave it deep green bay s jordan love leads the nfl with 21 completions of 25 plus yards and downfield pass yards 1 253 in 2026 per next gen stats new england s drake maye sits third in both categories but first in pass tds of 40 plus yards four so we should expect some explosive plays come sunday regardless of which pass catchers are healthy enough to take the field the one area that continues to trip me up is the packers run game that unit welcomed josh jacobs back from the commissioner s exempt list two games ago and nothing s changed green bay s averaging an nfl worst 60 6 rush yards per game in 2026 which would be the fewest by any team in a season since the 1970 merger and a ghastly 2 9 yards per carry i m not confident that changes sunday against a new england defense allowing the sixth fewest rush yards per game 92 6 it s a weakness the packers have been able to overcome in past weeks but it ll catch up to them this time why gennaro picked the seahawks in their first game of this season the cardinals upset the overrated chargers only to be smashed by the sam darnold less seahawks on the following sunday in their first game of this month the cardinals upset the overrated cowboys and look who s on the slate this sunday the sam darnold less seahawks with darnold sidelined this week by a fresh quad injury seattle plans to roll out drew lock against the cards once again as long as the backup qb isn t hindered by a recent elbow issue lock performed admirably in his winning spot start at arizona back in week 2 tossing three touchdown passes to jaxon smith njigba in an efficient outing that saw him complete over 73 of his throws and post a dazzling 139 1 passer rating can the second stringer log a second win over this division rival with jsn at his disposal and seattle s defense on his side lock doesn t have to play hero especially against an arizona team pulling its own levers at quarterback gardner minshew has taken the job from baltimore bound jacoby brissett do i believe in minshew mania well as a nothing to lose late game endeavor against the cowboys moribund defense sure but in the journeyman s first start of the season at seattle against the league s top ranked defense with the seahawks fresh off a humbling nationally televised home loss not so much mania is a fleeting sensation why dan picked the bears i believe the clock is about to strike midnight on the bucs recent cinderella like run after an 0 4 start to the season their recipe for success is not sustainable long term they won by 30 points a couple weeks ago despite throwing for just 64 yards and then they were victorious last week in a rain soaked game where they didn t complete a single pass becoming the first team since the 1974 buffalo bills to do so meanwhile the bears have planted their flag as legit contenders with prime time wins at home against the reigning afc champion patriots and on the road versus the reigning super bowl champion seahawks in consecutive weeks the defense is operating on a different level with trade acquisition jeffery simmons wreaking havoc and caleb williams is generating mvp chatter tampa bay s defense will be the best unit williams has faced since leaving chicago s week 2 loss to the vikings with the hamstring injury that sidelined him for three full games but i think it will take multiple takeaways by todd bowles group to jeopardize the bears winning streak the home team has more paths to victory than the bucs do right now monday nov 9 why bobby picked the bills with kyler murray battling a hamstring injury carson wentz is starting this game for the vikings frankly that development doesn t really change my feelings about this matchup which never hinged on the home team s quarterback minnesota s best chance at coming away with a victory will be to blitz josh allen into oblivion and hope it disrupts buffalo s offense enough to result in a low scoring slugfest defensive coordinator brian flores as everyone knows is very much up to that task his defense is blitzing at a rate of 71 0 which is 30 7 higher than the second ranked giants 40 3 per nfl pro for an idea of how absurd that is the gap between giants and the least blitz happy team bengals 18 9 is 21 4 compared to the rest of the league allen hasn t been particularly amazing against the blitz he is currently 20th out of 31 qualified quarterbacks with an 88 2 passer rating when facing extra rushers however that doesn t take into account the times he beats the blitz with his legs and running back james cook could also very well take some weight off allen s shoulders against a defense that is in the middle of the pack against the run while minnesota has allowed the fewest passing yards in the nfl it s giving up the 17th most rushing yards per game suffice it to say the bills will find a way to get theirs i m not so sure the vikings will which could result in a second straight loss to a premier offense they fail to keep up with thursday s game why bobby picked the jaguars jacksonville enters thursday night with the no 5 scoring offense and no 2 defense in points allowed while baltimore is limping into the prime time contest without star quarterback lamar jackson thumb for the long term not only that but backup tyler huntley is out for the season due to a turf toe injury there is a trade for jacoby brissett in the works but for at least one game the baton passes to undrafted rookie qb joe fagnano who went 10 of 21 for 91 yards and an interception after being thrust into the ravens week 8 loss to the bills as their emergency option will he improve enough to make a difference with an abbreviated week to prepare for his first ever nfl start it s hard to imagine especially facing a defense boasting the seventh highest pressure rate 39 6 in the league derrick henry has struggled during baltimore s three game losing streak he hasn t topped 58 yards rushing in any of those contests and zay flowers just put up a goose egg zero catches on five targets versus buffalo things are at risk of falling apart and the ravens don t exactly have one of their classic shutdown defenses of yesteryear to come to the rescue visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: Bengals' Joe Burrow enjoying Madrid's museums, feeling like ‘normal person’ ahead of Madrid game
news_mentions.description: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the NFL.
news_mentions.body_text: madrid cincinnati bengals quarterback joe burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the nfl burrow and the bengals are in madrid to take on the atlanta falcons on sunday looking to win their fourth straight game and move to 6 2 in the afc north the trip is not only about football for burrow though he was not yet with the bengals when the team played its first two games abroad in 2016 and 2019 in london this is somewhere that i ve always wanted to go he said friday and so to be able to do it while doing what i love playing football is really a dream come true for me burrow said he was recognized by a group of americans studying abroad while walking around the spanish capital but was enjoying a bit of anonymity on the streets of madrid i usually expect to go pretty incognito and not have anybody recognize me he said it s a little bit more than that but i love being out here because i can feel like a normal person for a little while art connoisseur europe was also allowing burrow to enjoy one of his passions art i went to museo del prado on wednesday that was cool burrow said of spain s renowned art museum and the plan for his half day off on friday was to go find more art in madrid i d like to go see some more museums and go to an art gallery do a little shopping but we ll see he said fashion change shopping in madrid could also be an attractive option for burrow who s been known for his interest in fashion and bold pregame outfits and it could be good timing for him as the bengals quarterback said he has been going through a style change i ve tried to elevate my looks a little bit recently he said for a couple of years there i was full streetwear and i started out going suits on gameday every day and didn t really feel like that was me so i switched it up to full streetwear and that might have been an overcorrection in my creative mind i m finding a happy medium now spanish sports knowledge burrow said he grew up watching soccer and lamented not being able to see one of the two spanish powerhouses play while he was in spain i ve followed international sports for a long time followed real madrid for a long time watched barcelona play real madrid a lot he said played with both of those teams on fifa a lot when i was a kid and loved watching soccer my whole life really so i wish they played while we were here at their home stadium so we could go unfortunately that s not gonna happen but hopefully one day i can make it putting on a show burrow said the bengals explosive and dynamic offense will be fun to watch at real madrid s santiago bernabeu stadium he said he was excited about being the nfl s main attraction sunday morning in the united states i love the only game on tv on sunday morning when people back home wake up and i love showcasing our talents abroad and trying to bring attention to what we do he said offensive line praise burrow threw for five touchdowns and ran for another in overtime as the bengals rallied to defeat the tennessee titans 43 36 last sunday we re completing a lot of passes right now our offensive line is protecting great i think this is the best that that group has played since i ve been here which is really exciting to see he said and you know a lot of our young players are getting better and better and we have the right guys who attack every day with the intent to be better than the day before and i think that is so valuable in this sport super bowl contenders burrow said the bengals still have more to prove before deserving to be considered super bowl contenders i don t think we deserve it yet he said we haven t done enough there s still a lot of season left we certainly have to be a lot better than we have been if we want to be that team at the end of the year winning the super bowl we certainly can we have the capability to do it but right now we aren t there no fast food for zac taylor bengals coach zac taylor joked that he wouldn t really accept anyone going for american fast food while in madrid i ve judged a couple people he said now my kids might be opting for that if you re under 14 years old yes if not i will judge you greatly wide receiver ja 39 marr chase was quick to say friday that he wasn t one of those going for fast food but he did say he missed his chef he also said he was recognized maybe twice on the streets of madrid on thursday defensive tackle dexter lawrence said he missed his bed copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Bengals vs. Falcons: Three must-know storylines for NFL Week 9 Madrid game
news_mentions.description: Does Atlanta excel in an area that could frustrate Joe Burrow? Will Bijan Robinson provide another sparkling performance in the spotlight? Jeremy Bergman provides three must-know storylines for Sunday's Bengals-Falcons game in Madrid.
news_mentions.body_text: this past summer spain sent its top footballers to the united states for a showcase of superior skill interplay and resolve the result la roja lifted its second world cup trophy campeones del mundo this sunday the nfl returns the favor in a way for the second time in as many years madrid is hosting a regular season nfl game but unlike last year s contest which featured a backup quarterback for washington and a dipping dolphins side this installment showcases two teams at near full strength with explosive ability and eyes on the postseason joe cool is on a heater for cincinnati one week removed from a maximalist six touchdown three interception outing in the bengals overtime victory over the lowly titans a win in madrid would bring cincy into a tie with the steelers atop the afc north ahead of their week 10 prime time matchup a 6 2 record would be the bengals best start since 2015 when they opened the season at 8 0 standing in their way the erratic falcons it s hard to get a grip on what the dirty birds are halfway through the season despite the sub 500 record atlanta is squarely in the nfc south race but you could say the same of any club in the uninspiring division including the buccaneers who shut out the falcons last sunday in a tampa typhoon without completing a pass the same falcons team that whooped up the packers in lambeau and handed the 49ers their only loss to date make it make sense that s a lesson for the host spaniards in the nfl any team can win on any given domingo when the bengals and falcons meet at the bernabeu on sunday in a uni matchup so bold it would make pedro almodovar blush expect the unexpected oh and unlike in that brutal world cup final against argentina expect scoring and lots of it three must know storylines 1 is there any slowing down cincy s offense the bengals have scored 78 points in the six quarters and change since a scoreless first half coming out of the bye in baltimore will their offensive onslaught continue in spain joe burrow paces the nfl in most notable passing stats 73 0 completion percentage 302 1 passing ypg 20 tds only four players in the super bowl era have ever led the league in all three of those categories in a season drew brees 2011 tom brady 2007 kurt warner 2001 and ken stabler 1976 it helps of course to have the nfl s top receiving tandem on your side burrow s passer ratings when targeting tee higgins 132 3 and ja 39 marr chase 113 6 each rank in the top five among qb wr tandems in the nfl it s a pick your poison deal for opposing defenses how will atlanta fare possibly quite well burrow might have the highest success rate on downfield passes in the next gen stats era since 2016 but the falcons are feisty 10 yards past the line of scrimmage they ve allowed 2 0 yards of separation on downfield targets the second lowest mark in the nfl and have forced a tight window on 34 8 of those targets the second highest rate plus atlanta is one of two defenses yet to allow a td on a deep pass 20 air yards this season the falcons are a turnover happy bunch as well logging at least one takeaway in seven of eight games including four against brock purdy s then unbeaten 49ers if atlanta can force burrow into some of the same mistakes he made against tennessee perhaps the bengals can be tamed through the air one thing s for sure unlike the falcons last opponent cincinnati will complete at least one pass right 2 another big day for bijan in a solo window no one in the nfl performs better in prime time than bijan robinson a 3 30 local time start in madrid isn t quite like playing under the sunday night lights but it is an exclusive tv window for robinson and the falcons which could mean a showcase for the show stopper the nfl s leading rusher has paced atlanta s fifth ranked run game at one point producing three straight gems in prime time see 478 total yards against green bay new orleans and baltimore in weeks 3 5 robinson has slowed over the last three weeks though the falcons ground game was the only thing even moderately functional in the rain soaked loss at tampa with michael penix throwing four picks is this international stage the perfect platform for a bijan bounce back cincy revamped its defensive front in the offseason and it has paid dividends overall the bengals have stuffed 31 7 of outside zone runs the highest rate in the nfl and a good trend against robinson who averages an nfl best 6 5 yards per carry on outside zone runs with a 53 2 success rate plus though robinson is a great tackle breaker averaging 4 3 yards per carry on runs where he is hit at or behind the line of scrimmage the best rate through eight games by anyone since 2018 the bengals tend not to allow such big gains they ve yielded 0 7 yards per carry second fewest when they ve hit the runner at or behind the line and their 24 5 stuff rate on designed runs is the highest in the nfl an acquaintance of real madrid and france star striker kylian mbappe robinson can only hope that in dexter lawrence and the bengals front he is not like mbappe running into the spanish backline bound for a shutout 3 an international brotherhood in this seventh international matchup of the nfl s historic nine game slate in 2026 a unique meeting is set to take place when the bengals offense faces the falcons defense cincinnati starting running back chase brown and atlanta defensive back sydney brown are set to square off against one another for the second time a battle of twin brothers on foreign soil the european encounter won t feel too strange though after all the browns journey to this moment has been an international one born in london ontario canada the brothers made their entry into the united states in high school when they relocated to bradenton florida from there sydney attended the university of illinois while chase initially went to western michigan before rejoining his brother for four seasons on the fighting illini sydney was a third round pick of philadelphia in 2023 while chase went to cincinnati in the fifth the brothers first played one another in 2024 when sydney s eagles stomped chase s bengals 37 17 in the game chase found the end zone while sydney logged three defensive snaps now the browns will meet again this time across the ocean from their homelands original and adopted chase is coming off his most productive game in what has been a slow start to the season 101 scrimmage yards versus tennessee through eight contests in his first year in atlanta sydney has logged 28 tackles one tfl a pass defensed and a forced fumble perhaps before they presumably meet to exchange jerseys after the game the brothers brown sons of ontario will collide in the middle of madrid s famed bernabeu hermano a hermano

news_mentions.headline: Jaguars-Ravens on 'Thursday Night Football': What We Learned from Jacksonville's 33-10 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Grant Gordon breaks down Jacksonville's road rout of the undermanned Ravens on Thursday night.
news_mentions.body_text: just in case you didn t know these jags are legit making their prime time season debut on thursday night the jaguars took care of business and reminded viewers or perhaps notified them for the first time that they are a very legitimate championship contender whether that s simply to retain their afc south crown which seems like almost a chip shot at this point or to make some very real noise in the postseason will remain to be seen this rainy evening was hardly some beautiful exhibition of football glory but aside from a few snafus the jaguars did what they ve been doing all season by blowing out another opponent coming off a 42 7 savaging of the colts that stands as the largest win in the league so far jacksonville had three wins in 2026 by 24 plus points no other team owns more than one and the jaguars came one point short of another thursday night one can argue this wasn t a fair fight the ravens started a rookie undrafted free agent at quarterback after all but eight games into the season we can t dock a team for simply taking care of business we need to laud them in the any given sunday atmosphere of the nfl it s impressive when a good team does what it s supposed to jacksonville had its stumble in week 6 with its loss to a disappointing texans squad but thursday served as a microcosm of the jaguars year so far trevor lawrence is playing mvp caliber ball using an assortment of talented skill position options to aplomb all while the defense and special teams play terrifically as well pomp and circumstance have hardly been prevalent but lopsided wins have thursday night showed these jaguars are ready for prime time and long overdue for recognition as an nfl heavyweight ravens are reeling it s pouring down in baltimore the rain the boos the losses they were all coming down on thursday night as baltimore lost its fourth in a row it was no doubt an uphill climb trying to topple one of the afc s best with an undrafted free agent quarterback joe fagnano under center it s just not that simple though baltimore had five accepted penalties for 31 yards in the first half to set a horrible tone the offensive game plan was clearly to milk the clock get creative and use smoke and mirrors to help fagnano find his way derrick henry took some snaps at quarterback attempted a pass and there was plenty of trickery in the backfield but it played out like a plan to lose by a slimmer margin rather than trying to go out swinging looking for a win fagnano attempted one pass all night of more than 10 yards as the offense drew boos and gained little baltimore s defense rookie head coach jesse minter s calling card hardly stood up to the occasion continuing a campaign in which it s been a massive letdown baltimore allowed seven scoring drives the injuries to lamar jackson and tyler huntley are overwhelming the offensive line has been ravaged by injuries as well heck kicker tyler loop is on injured reserve too veteran quarterback jacoby brissett is reportedly joining the fray in the coming days but more than the qb position needs saving here though brissett should open up the playbook more than it was on thursday he hasn t started a game for a team that made the playoffs since his 2016 rookie season with the patriots minter was tasked with leading a super bowl contender to turn the corner and those best aspirations are getting washed away in a hurry jaguars d tears up ravens the no 2 defense in points allowed heading into week 9 the jaguars shut down the ravens offense allowing three points on baltimore s first drive and nothing for the next nine possessions until justice hill broke loose for a 65 yard touchdown run baltimore had just 227 yards of offense 10 first downs and was 4 of 14 on third down the basic stats and arithmetic were ugly jacksonville racked up three takeaways an interception by montaric brown another pick by jourdan lewis and a fumble recovery on a kickoff return despite losing defensive tackle davon hamilton for the season earlier in the week the no 1 rushing defense held the line against derrick henry confining him to 57 yards on 17 carries the pass rush has been problematic for the jags and it wasn t great on thursday generating a 30 pressure rate but it really made no matter jacksonville has now won four games in which it s held an opponent to 10 points or less trevor just keeps getting it done with time winding down chants of trev er lore ence broke out at m t bank stadium jaguars fans had taken over with disgruntled ravens fans leaving for drier and less frustrating ground lawrence finished the evening completing 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards and a 50 yard touchdown to parker washington it s anything but a flashy stat line but this was an ugly night weather wise and the ravens did their best to slow play things lawrence s mvp candidacy remains alive he s hardly the front runner but he s the face and symbol of an ascending afc power there isn t all that much sizzle but there s plenty of substance this wasn t a game for big fantasy pleasing numbers just results that really matter lawrence who hasn t thrown an interception in 10 quarters completed throws to eight pass catchers and finished with a 105 0 passer rating his qb rating sits at a league high 111 7 after thursday just ahead of joe burrow 111 6 lawrence is getting it done in splendid if not spectacular fashion and the jags are following his lead which is currently a very healthy advantage in the afc south life without lamar it s never easy playing without your starting quarterback much less when it s lamar jackson a transcendent talent and two time ap nfl most valuable player unfortunately it s not been an uncommon occurrence having returned from an ankle sprain last week only to be lost likely for the season with a thumb injury the ravens have to soldier forward without him and backup tyler huntley who is out for the season thursday dropped baltimore s record to 7 14 without jackson since he took over the starting reins for the club in 2018 now with jackson on injured reserve and his season all but officially over his future with the franchise has become a prevailing topic and it won t cease being a discussion point anytime soon the ravens and jackson couldn t work out an extension this offseason and the final year of his current contract is 2027 his age 30 season and one in which his contract poses an 84 34 million cap hit before any of that is resolved the ravens still have another nine games in the regular season over the last four in which jackson played one snap total derrick henry has rushed for less than 60 yards in each game there is a domino effect unsurprisingly without jackson the future beyond this year is unclear and the rest of this one is increasingly murky next gen stats insight for jaguars ravens via nfl pro ravens qb joe fagnano was 0 for 1 on downfield passes 10 plus air yards trevor lawrence completed eight of his 10 downfield attempts for 193 yards and a touchdown against the ravens his most downfield passing yards in a game and second highest downfield completion rate 80 of the season nfl research derrick henry was held to 57 yards on thursday but he improved to 13 707 in his career surpassing hall of famers jerome bettis 13 662 yards ninth place all time and ladainian tomlinson 13 684 eighth to move into seventh place on all time in rushing yards

news_mentions.headline: AFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bengals, Browns, Ravens, Steelers
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top AFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Baltimore Ravens, Cincinnati Bengals, Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns and pittsburgh steelers catch up on each afc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns pittsburgh steelers three key storylines 1 minter era begins john harbaugh is gone and in steps rookie head coach jesse minter to replace him baltimore needed a fresh start minter is the face of it but with a fresh start comes uncertainty is minter capable of preparing and directing his team toward the super bowl contention that has become the standard expectation in the charm city will the shift from harbaugh to minter a product of the harbaugh family coaching tree be enough to push the ravens back into the postseason or is the similarity between the two too close to produce meaningful change it s not often a team changes coaches and is still expected to compete for division titles and more but that s where the ravens find themselves and as is always the case with rookie coaches there s plenty of learning ahead for better or worse does this move boost baltimore back to the top of the division or will the ravens suffer another disappointing finish like in 2025 2 new oc for lamar with a new coaching staff in baltimore lamar jackson has a new offensive coordinator declan doyle is only 30 years old and less than a year older than jackson which could produce a deeper level of understanding between coach and quarterback but he s a largely unproven play caller doyle spent his first season as an oc under offensive mastermind ben johnson in chicago meaning he wasn t holding the play sheet now he will be jackson who is embracing the new system will need to adjust quickly and help the new coordinator establish a rapport with him in order to maximize the potential of the offense which returns derrick henry mark andrews zay flowers and rashod bateman among others baltimore must find a replacement for departed tight end isaiah likely but if doyle is anything like the coach he spent 2025 under the new oc should produce positive results even if it takes a bit to get going 3 a restored defense a hidden detail in the ravens 2025 struggles existed in their defense a unit that is traditionally a strength but was a sieve early in the campaign the main reason defensive lineman nnamdi madubuike went down with a serious neck injury exposing a weakness and lack of depth up front that rendered baltimore s d mostly ineffective except for the moments in which safety kyle hamilton played superhero to save the day that s not sustainable and the ravens acted accordingly this offseason signing trey hendrickson to restore a fearsome presence in the pass rushing unit madubuike could return in 2026 too and age defying defensive end calais campbell has rejoined the ravens to give them some much needed depth this is the group that minter will direct and regardless of what happens offensively this unit s performance will determine how far baltimore can go in 2026 back to top three key storylines 1 can defense finally deliver a year after navigating the choppy dramatic waters that came with trey hendrickson s holdout the bengals are in a much better place defensively they invested significantly in that side of the ball adding dt jonathan allen de boye mafe s bryan cook and s kyle dugger in free agency before swinging a major trade for dt dexter lawrence on paper cincinnati has finally upgraded defensively and appears poised to chase a super bowl but we all know depth charts only matter so much the bengals defensive inadequacies have led to great frustration in the midst of a third straight playoff less season last december joe burrow openly wondered about his football future largely because he was exasperated by the frequent challenges and predictable disappointments if the d is fixed there s reason to believe these bengals can return to the postseason and embark on a deep run 2 burrow s health can joe burrow stay healthy for once while most of the blame for this team s recent struggles has been rightfully pinned on the defense burrow s lack of availability has also been a near annual problem last season a toe injury required surgery and knocked him out for nine games sending the bengals into a crisis mode that prompted them to trade for joe flacco by the time burrow returned cincinnati needed to be nearly perfect to rescue its playoff hopes an impossible goal the flawed bengals failed to reach in 2023 a similar story played out when burrow missed cincinnati s final seven games due to a season ending wrist injury as is the case with every nfl franchise the bengals title hopes ride on the quarterback s availability that will continue to be true in 2026 3 taylor under major pressure the pressure is on cincinnati s head coach a defensible case could have been made for zac taylor s dismissal after 2025 instead he emerged as the only returning coach in the afc north entering 2026 this time around the usual excuses don t exist the defense is improved and if burrow stays healthy he has the pieces necessary to produce at an elite clip if cincy doesn t live up to the lofty expectations set by burrow the blame will fall on taylor s shoulders his team must succeed in 2026 there is no alternative three key storylines 1 new era begins under monken after six seasons the browns sent kevin stefanski packing terminating a two time nfl coach of the year who produced cleveland s only playoff win since the browns returned as an expansion franchise in 1999 in the same breath owner jimmy haslam opted to retain general manager andrew berry touting the personnel chief s strong 2025 draft class and strangely the improvement of kicker andre szmyt as justification for keeping him around berry responded by compiling another draft class that has plenty of potential in 2026 and continues to rebuild the franchise after overseeing the worst decision made by a gm in the last 25 years if not longer trading three first round picks for deshaun watson who also received a fully guaranteed 230 million contract berry replaced stefanski with veteran oc todd monken who makes his head coaching debut with a team that still isn t quite stocked for legitimate contention monken s arrival seems to have breathed new life into the young browns but with results pending that s all we know about the monken era as of now the most important lesson we could learn from the browns this year might be how much patience haslam possesses because it s unlikely this team will suddenly become a contender in 2026 it s up to monken to get the most out of his players in his first season at the helm 2 serious qb questions cleveland is revamping its offensive approach which had become rather stale under stefanski with monken in charge and travis switzer serving as a first time coordinator a new scheme can t cover for a lack of reliability at quarterback though the browns appear to be laying the groundwork for watson to emerge from irrelevance and regain the starting job while 2025 fifth round pick shedeur sanders lurks in the shadows how long watson holds on to the reins is another story but unless the 30 year old pulls off a miracle and returns to his houston form browns fans can prepare for another season filled with frustration under center which might play perfectly into a plan to select a top signal caller in 2027 s loaded draft 3 how will defense look without garrett and schwartz myles garrett reset the single season sack record in 2025 which proved to be his final campaign in brown and orange berry took a massive swing when he agreed to a forward thinking trade with the rams sending garrett to los angeles in exchange for young star edge rusher jared verse and a collection of picks that includes the rams 2027 first round selection garrett s departure means the browns lose 23 sacks worth of production from last season plus a persistent concern carried by every opposing offense add in the departure of respected coordinator jim schwartz and suddenly cleveland s defense its better side in the last two challenging seasons harbors plenty of questions fortunately the browns still have some studs on that side of the ball defensive rookie of the year carson schwesinger five time pro bowl corner denzel ward verse and promising sophomore defensive tackle mason graham but they re going to need to prove the personnel is strong enough to overcome a change in sideline leadership back to top three key storylines 1 no guarantees in life post tomlin mike mccarthy is back in the nfl having returned to his beloved hometown of pittsburgh to lead a steelers team that is taking on a much different appearance than usual instead of replacing one longtime coach with a young star the steelers opted for the veteran with super bowl experience in mccarthy a move some interpreted as a ploy to convince aaron rodgers to return for a 22nd nfl season if that was indeed the plan it worked whether it bears fruit however remains to be seen mccarthy s track record of directing explosive offenses should encourage steelers fans who have grown tired of watching low ceiling units struggle to compete so too should the acquisition of veteran receiver michael pittman but much of this feels like it s held together by chicken wire at least as of now pittsburgh s backup options behind rodgers are longtime reserve mason rudolph 2025 sixth round pick will howard and 2026 third rounder drew allar if crisis strikes at qb visions of a playoff victory something the steelers haven t achieved since the 2016 campaign will evaporate ideally the mccarthy rodgers partnership evokes memories of their days in green bay that s far from a guarantee along with the steelers annual assuredness to finish at or above 500 now that mike tomlin has left the coaching ranks for a job in television 2 run game concerns pittsburgh became one of the leaders in the nfl s sudden shift toward tight end reliant sets in 2025 leaning on the likes of darnell washington pat freiermuth jonnu smith and connor heyward to beef up and bulldoze opposing defenses though smith and heyward are no longer on the roster the first round selection of arizona state ot max iheanachor should help the ground game but is the backfield good enough jaylen warren is pittsburgh s lead back while rico dowdle arrives via free agency to give the steelers an explosive weapon capable of posting a few huge days as evidenced by his 389 yard outburst in weeks 5 and 6 for carolina last season kaleb johnson however remains a question mark the iowa product averaged just 2 5 yards per carry on 28 attempts as a rookie and hasn t yet proven he can be counted on as a rugged power back pittsburgh will have the hogs to move defenses and create rushing lanes but it will be up to mccarthy to deploy his personnel properly in order to stay on schedule and remain balanced especially with the largely immobile rodgers in the lineup 3 graham to get d back on track tomlin s departure meant the arrival of a new defensive coordinator and mccarthy selected the experienced patrick graham as his new director pittsburgh s defense is paid well but hasn t lived up to expectations of late finishing 26th in total d under former dc teryl austin in 2025 graham s track record isn t a slam dunk either in his last three stops dolphins giants raiders his defenses have hovered near league average peaking at 12th in 2020 with new york and bottoming out at 30th with miami in 2019 to his credit graham found some consistency amid dysfunction in las vegas over the last three seasons guiding the raiders to two 15th place finishes in 2023 and 24 before improving slightly to 14th but 25th in scoring d in 2025 he ll have better talent in pittsburgh which means the true test of his expertise should arrive in 2026 luckily he s working under a coach with a reputation for leading potent offenses if graham can prove himself to be a worthy dc then the steelers might actually be in business back to top

material_news_signals.headline: Bengals' Joe Burrow enjoying Madrid's museums, feeling like ‘normal person’ ahead of Madrid game
material_news_signals.description: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the NFL.
material_news_signals.body_text: madrid cincinnati bengals quarterback joe burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the nfl burrow and the bengals are in madrid to take on the atlanta falcons on sunday looking to win their fourth straight game and move to 6 2 in the afc north the trip is not only about football for burrow though he was not yet with the bengals when the team played its first two games abroad in 2016 and 2019 in london this is somewhere that i ve always wanted to go he said friday and so to be able to do it while doing what i love playing football is really a dream come true for me burrow said he was recognized by a group of americans studying abroad while walking around the spanish capital but was enjoying a bit of anonymity on the streets of madrid i usually expect to go pretty incognito and not have anybody recognize me he said it s a little bit more than that but i love being out here because i can feel like a normal person for a little while art connoisseur europe was also allowing burrow to enjoy one of his passions art i went to museo del prado on wednesday that was cool burrow said of spain s renowned art museum and the plan for his half day off on friday was to go find more art in madrid i d like to go see some more museums and go to an art gallery do a little shopping but we ll see he said fashion change shopping in madrid could also be an attractive option for burrow who s been known for his interest in fashion and bold pregame outfits and it could be good timing for him as the bengals quarterback said he has been going through a style change i ve tried to elevate my looks a little bit recently he said for a couple of years there i was full streetwear and i started out going suits on gameday every day and didn t really feel like that was me so i switched it up to full streetwear and that might have been an overcorrection in my creative mind i m finding a happy medium now spanish sports knowledge burrow said he grew up watching soccer and lamented not being able to see one of the two spanish powerhouses play while he was in spain i ve followed international sports for a long time followed real madrid for a long time watched barcelona play real madrid a lot he said played with both of those teams on fifa a lot when i was a kid and loved watching soccer my whole life really so i wish they played while we were here at their home stadium so we could go unfortunately that s not gonna happen but hopefully one day i can make it putting on a show burrow said the bengals explosive and dynamic offense will be fun to watch at real madrid s santiago bernabeu stadium he said he was excited about being the nfl s main attraction sunday morning in the united states i love the only game on tv on sunday morning when people back home wake up and i love showcasing our talents abroad and trying to bring attention to what we do he said offensive line praise burrow threw for five touchdowns and ran for another in overtime as the bengals rallied to defeat the tennessee titans 43 36 last sunday we re completing a lot of passes right now our offensive line is protecting great i think this is the best that that group has played since i ve been here which is really exciting to see he said and you know a lot of our young players are getting better and better and we have the right guys who attack every day with the intent to be better than the day before and i think that is so valuable in this sport super bowl contenders burrow said the bengals still have more to prove before deserving to be considered super bowl contenders i don t think we deserve it yet he said we haven t done enough there s still a lot of season left we certainly have to be a lot better than we have been if we want to be that team at the end of the year winning the super bowl we certainly can we have the capability to do it but right now we aren t there no fast food for zac taylor bengals coach zac taylor joked that he wouldn t really accept anyone going for american fast food while in madrid i ve judged a couple people he said now my kids might be opting for that if you re under 14 years old yes if not i will judge you greatly wide receiver ja 39 marr chase was quick to say friday that he wasn t one of those going for fast food but he did say he missed his chef he also said he was recognized maybe twice on the streets of madrid on thursday defensive tackle dexter lawrence said he missed his bed copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Jonathan Taylor landing spots: Ranking top 7 trade fits for Colts Pro Bowl running back
news_mentions.description: With the NFL’s Nov. 10 trade deadline days away, all eyes are on Jonathan Taylor and the Colts. Kevin Patra identifies seven possible destinations for the star RB.
news_mentions.body_text: with the nfl s nov 10 trade deadline days away all eyes are on jonathan taylor and the indianapolis colts with indy in clear rebuild mode after firing general manager chris ballard moving the veteran running back could return valuable draft capital while the jury is still out on whether the colts will get their trade price met for taylor several squads could use a pro bowl running back as we push toward thanksgiving let s take a quick gander at some potential landing spots for the former all pro running back the league s worst rushing attack could certainly use some help green bay is averaging a measly 60 6 yards per game and has four total rushing touchdowns worse they re not even getting the yards blocked per next gen stats the packers have a comical 164 rush yards over expected they re averaging 1 0 rush yards over expected per carry woof the pack hoped that josh jacobs return would jumpstart the unit while he s been better than marshawn watch me bounce everything outside lloyd jacobs too has been woefully inefficient jacobs has just 75 rushing yards in two games averaging 2 3 yards per carry and has 1 1 rush yards over expected per carry as a team the packers have 27 total missed tackles forced a trade for taylor would immediately help and green bay could potentially move on from jacobs in 2027 if not sooner the question is whether brian gutekunst who played it conservatively with his backfield entering the season would shell out the draft picks needed to make the deal i m not holding my breath even though the fit makes sense the minnesota passing offense has been horrific with kyler murray at the helm carson wentz may coax more consistency this week but a long term upgrade at running back could help solve another issue for the vikings aaron jones and jordan mason have dealt with injuries and while they have generated yardage it s been inefficient jones is averaging 0 5 rush yards over expected this season and mason sits at 0 3 the vikings run attack lacks explosive plays jones and mason have combined for 14 runs of 10 plus yards taylor has 18 alone this season minnesota s poor interior blocking has played a role but the inability of the vikings backs to break tackles has led to a stymied attack 24 combined missed tackles forced from jones and mason taylor has 35 upgrading the rushing attack would help make the passing attack easier by keeping the vikings in better down and distance situations john harbaugh hasn t been shy about checking in on upgrades up and down the roster for the nfc east leaders while the giants have other needs adding a player of taylor s caliber would certainly boost j j mccarthy and the offense injuries have siphoned off the depth of the backfield tyrone tracy is on injured reserve and starter cam skattebo is dealing with a hamstring injury devin singletary stands as the primary back if skattebo can t go this week taylor and skatt would make a nice one two punch that big blue could lean on down the stretch a splash move at the deadline could go a long way to ensuring the giants keep their division lead into january and provide them a chance to pull off a postseason upset there has been scuttlebutt for weeks about the broncos potentially trading for taylor the denver rushing attack can t find a groove ranking in the bottom seven in yards per game 92 6 and sitting 26th with a 36 2 run success rate broncos rbs have combined for 10 runs of 10 plus yards this season rj harvey landing on injured reserve wiped out one option j k dobbins has been inefficient averaging 3 3 yards per carry with 100 rush yards over expected jonah coleman has shown some upside the past two weeks since returning from injury including posting 104 scrimmage yards in week 8 is it enough to quiet the concerns cincy is possibly the most interesting landing spot for taylor chase brown is a solid dual threat back and the bengals are a pass funnel offense behind joe burrow however adding an upper echelon runner could provide a completely different dimension to the offense it d be a play for the playoffs when a ground attack could be even more beneficial particularly in bad weather games cincinnati has attempted 21 9 rushes per game second fewest in the nfl behind only green bay on 94 carries brown has generated 340 yards and one td with a 35 1 success rate taylor could provide a completely different tackle breaking element pair taylor s ability to slam through light boxes with burrow s dive bombing ability and the bengals chances of returning to the super bowl would skyrocket injuries and ineffectiveness have forced washington to cycle through backs this year jacory croskey merritt still leads the commanders in rushing despite landing on injured reserve after only five games rachaad white has offered no consistency austin ekeler is 31 coming off a season ending injury and jeremy mcnichols is out for the season it s not pretty even at 2 4 1 washington isn t out of the nfc east hunt this week could be significant for that race taylor s multi year contract also puts the commanders in play for me he d provide jayden daniels a reliable running mate beyond 2026 and solve a significant problem in d c news of treveyon henderson s unexpected medical emergency gives the pats more incentive to upgrade the backfield rhamondre stevenson has averaged 3 8 yards per carry corey kiner who has impressed in limited opportunities and generated 29 rush yards over expected on just 42 carries could see a significant increase in reps however with henderson sidelined we shouldn t rule out the pats who have surged back into contention from making a splash

news_mentions.headline: Pats' TreVeyon Henderson says he was hospitalized after 'unusual' emergency; RB focused on recovery
news_mentions.description: Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson said in a statement Friday that he was recently hospitalized after experiencing "an unexpected and unusual medical emergency" and is currently focused on his recovery and "long-term well-being."
news_mentions.body_text: new england patriots running back treveyon henderson said in a statement released friday that he was recently hospitalized after experiencing a medical emergency and is currently focused on his recovery and long term well being recently i experienced an unexpected and unusual medical emergency involving a series of unexplained neurological symptoms that required hospitalization for several days henderson wrote during that time i underwent extensive medical testing and evaluation while the results of my comprehensive medical testing have come back positive and reassuring the cause of this remains unknown and unexplainable henderson missed new england s week 8 win over miami due to what the team called an illness henderson has not practiced since oct 28 he was added to the injury report with an illness on oct 29 the former ohio state back suffered a high ankle sprain in new england s week 5 win over las vegas and was expected to miss multiple games but played the very next week in a victory over the rival jets henderson s most recent appearance was in the patriots week 7 loss to chicago on oct 22 logging five touches for 23 yards on 12 snaps henderson said in his statement on friday that he continues to work with specialists and physical therapists to focus on my recovery as these symptoms have affected my strength coordination and some of my physical functions i am committed to doing everything necessary to return to full health the patriots rb added my health and long term well being remain my foremost priorities patriots coach mike vrabel said the team will support henderson amid his health struggles i know that he is well loved and respected on this football team vrabel said friday i ll support him the best way that i know how is just to care for him listen to him and do whatever we can to get him healthy and get back and to help this football team and to do what he loves vrabel did not put a timeline on henderson s return adding we ll see if new england places henderson on the non football injury list in his second season with new england henderson has played second fiddle to rhamondre stevenson in the backfield in six games played the former second round pick has totaled 248 yards from scrimmage and a touchdown on 57 touches without henderson against the dolphins new england relied on stevenson corey kiner and practice squad call up lan larison vrabel said he doesn t plan to add any rbs to the roster the pats 5 3 host the green bay packers 5 3 at gillette stadium on sunday at 4 25 p m et

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top
