news_mentions.headline: Myles Garrett's return could unleash Aaron Donald and lift an injury-hit Rams defense
news_mentions.body_text: los angeles myles garrett trotted out of the los angeles rams facility and onto the green grass for his first practice in nearly two months and byron young couldn 39 t contain himself 34 get your cameras ready 34 young shouted 34 i 39 m so happy to see this 34 garrett spent the beginning of thursday 39 s practice chatting and trading jokes with aaron donald who ended a two year retirement this summer in part for a moment like the one coming after a career of double teams he wanted to share a defensive line with another multi time defensive player of the year whenever that time would come the rams would feature the first defensive line in nfl history with two players with at least 100 career sacks and a 20 sack season under their belt this was the delayed euphoria expanding like a balloon that was ready to burst not only have the rams waited months since a blockbuster trade to see the real version of their two time defensive player of the year in a game week setting but they also needed a reprieve from the avalanche that continues to fall on their heads garrett 39 s status for sunday against the washington commanders remains to be seen but his return to practice came in a week filled with more injury chaos on the day los angeles decided to start the practice window for garrett who has missed seven straight games after knee surgery the team placed cornerback jaylen watson on season ending injured reserve with a shoulder injury that means the rams won 39 t play a snap this season with the four acquisitions they brought in to level up the defense garrett donald watson and two time all pro cornerback trent mcduffie on the field at the same time mcduffie himself is fighting to get back on the field after he injured his back in sunday 39 s 24 9 victory over the los angeles chargers he 39 s missed two practices this week in the attempt to heal the roller coaster of emotions on one side of the ball contains a conundrum as week 9 approaches for this 4 4 team the rams 39 defense has a chance to be special but it also has to overcome so much to be so 34 i 39 ve been the coach for 10 years and i know 39 22 was a season that we had a lot of injuries particularly at the offensive line 34 coach sean mcvay said 34 but this has been more than any year including 39 22 with the amount of guys out at different spots that are key and critical to your identities 34 the rams have to overcome the loss of watson whose nine pass deflections erasures with press man coverage and stout run defense have set a new tone for a secondary that badly needed one after last season 39 s playoff slide they will look to josh wallace and emmanuel forbes for help and both could wind up playing on the perimeter if mcduffie misses more time enough is up in the air that the rams added eighth year veteran david long to the practice squad for insurance they also have to continue to absorb the losses of nose tackle poona ford and defensive end kobie turner ford is out for the season and the replacement tandem of ty hamilton and tyler davis helped shut down the las vegas raiders and chargers for 112 combined rushing yards on 2 7 yards per carry the past two weeks the run defense has improved over the past two weeks in part because the rams faced struggling run games and in part because of the rise of linebacker omar speights but garrett can provide an antidote to so many of the concerns if he can get back to form he plays in the edge spot turner does on base downs where he can set a similar edge with his 272 pound frame turner has to miss the next two games while on injured reserve with a groin injury but it 39 s when the rams force teams into throwing the ball that garrett will make up the most ground he joins a team tied for 26th in the nfl with 12 sacks just one year ago los angeles finished tied for seventh in the league with 47 sacks that same season with the cleveland browns garrett had 23 on his lonesome for the most in a season in nfl history garrett 39 s injury created a double blow to the pass rush as the rams sent jared verse to the browns to get him verse finished last season with 7 1 2 sacks and led the team with a 17 5 percent pressure rate according to sports info solutions garrett was here to supercharge his role of commanding double teams and chip blocks while collapsing the blind side of the pocket to chase quarterbacks to the right where byron young could chase them down with his speed young leads the rams this season with 4 1 2 sacks and a 14 7 percent pressure rate but he 39 s trying to get back to and then exceed last season 39 s totals of 12 sacks and a 15 5 percent pressure rate which landed him in his first pro bowl 34 we were doing a get off in practice and i was like 39 boy i 39 ve missed that 39 34 young said 34 i feel like we 39 ve been getting good pressure but we 39 re not getting the quarterback down that happened a few games ago and that 39 s something we don 39 t live by we live by getting after the quarterback and getting him down and finishing games 34 having him be back i 39 m looking for that to help us along the way all of the attention he 39 s going to cause by getting to the qb i 39 m looking forward to it 34 but the biggest beneficiary of a healthy garrett would be donald after all the prospect of rushing as a secondary option in the eyes of opposing offensive lines is what became so enticing about a comeback that has largely disappeared with josaiah stewart in garrett 39 s place but the math dilemma can return on offensive lines trying to divvy up resources on the same side of the line garrett and donald play on 34 he 39 s looking good looking fast 34 donald said of garrett 34 we 39 re getting to work with him in full pads and playing off each other it looked pretty good today so i 39 m excited about having him here having him back and seeing what we do sunday 34 and if that comes together the rams have a way to ease the burden on their outside cornerbacks they have reason to be optimistic about wallace given the surge he 39 s shown in his third season he 39 s playing outside more than ever and he 39 s allowed just six of 20 passes against him to be completed for a total of 77 yards and no touchdowns according to sis only one cornerback in the nfl has allowed less than his 3 9 yards per coverage snap allowed on at least 20 targets and that 39 s his teammate mcduffie at 3 3 the rams will likely dial up their use of zone looks without watson 39 s press man presence that can allow the secondary to play downhill and with eyes on the quarterback safety quentin lake is tied for second in the league with three interceptions and mcduffie is one behind him with two despite two missed games but the real boost could come to free safety kam kinchens who had six interceptions across his first two seasons but has yet to get his hands on one this season the path is there for the rams to rise from a high floor defense to an impactful one they rank no 5 in the league in yards allowed and no 12 in points but are in the bottom 10 in sacks and takeaways that 39 s where having garrett donald and mcduffie playing together for the first time could pay dividends so long as garrett and mcduffie are healthy that 39 s why the building has a swirl of emotions right now this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Ravens' play 'not acceptable' in latest blowout loss to Jaguars
news_mentions.description: The Baltimore Ravens lost their fourth straight contest, and third consecutive by 20-plus points.
news_mentions.body_text: it s getting ugly in baltimore the ravens got shellacked thursday night in a rain soaked 33 10 loss to the jacksonville jaguars it marked the first time in franchise history that baltimore haslost by 20 plus points in three consecutive games obviously it s a tough situation for our guys but i just told them there s no excuses there s no whatever we don t have this guy we don t have that guy coach jesse minter said after the loss the defense was out there it felt like the whole half i thought they battled and fought and did a decent job in the second half but obviously the results are not acceptable for us and what we re after losing quarterbacks lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury forced the ravens to start undrafted rookie joe fagnano on a short week the results were what you d expect the qb completed 10 of 18 passes for 60 yards threw two interceptions and took one sack the ravens rarely gave the rookie a chance to rip it and he didn t take it on the precious few early opportunities baltimore tried to lean on the ground game using derrick henry in the wildcat and copious amounts of misdirection you can dress up a ham sandwich with any number of accoutrements as you d like it s still a ham sandwich baltimore was held to 227 total yards and 10 first downs going 4 of 14 on third down and turning it over three times henry was slowed to 57 yards on 17 carries the soaked locals expressed their displeasure with loud halloween themed interjections before heading home early they have every right to boo or do whatever they want to do tight end mark andrews said obviously we re not used to this type of outcome it s not acceptable the lame duck offense will get the headlines but minter s defense has been among the most disappointing units in the entire nfl despite sporting pro bowl players at every level baltimore s d has been ripped up allowing 30 plus points in three straight games guys are frustrated defensive lineman calais campbell said but you got to take some pride in your work and you got to figure out a way at this point in time it s draw a line in the sand and decide where we go from here the offense not staying on the field surely has something to do with a defense that has morphed into a sieve the counter however is the opening drive a seven play touchdown march by the jags on thursday night on which the defense offered little resistance minter s defense has been average to below in nearly every statistical category this season thursday night when it was clear the offense would struggle with a backup qb in poor conditions the defense needed to carry the day previous iterations in baltimore would have instead the ravens broke it wasn t good enough we ve got to be better a clearly frustrated henry said it was the same story it wasn t good enough we ve got to be better with four straight losses sending them to 4 5 before a week 10 date with the current winless los angeles chargers they need to get a whole lot better fast to have any chance at saving the season

news_mentions.headline: Jaguars-Ravens on 'Thursday Night Football': What We Learned from Jacksonville's 33-10 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Grant Gordon breaks down Jacksonville's road rout of the undermanned Ravens on Thursday night.
news_mentions.body_text: just in case you didn t know these jags are legit making their prime time season debut on thursday night the jaguars took care of business and reminded viewers or perhaps notified them for the first time that they are a very legitimate championship contender whether that s simply to retain their afc south crown which seems like almost a chip shot at this point or to make some very real noise in the postseason will remain to be seen this rainy evening was hardly some beautiful exhibition of football glory but aside from a few snafus the jaguars did what they ve been doing all season by blowing out another opponent coming off a 42 7 savaging of the colts that stands as the largest win in the league so far jacksonville had three wins in 2026 by 24 plus points no other team owns more than one and the jaguars came one point short of another thursday night one can argue this wasn t a fair fight the ravens started a rookie undrafted free agent at quarterback after all but eight games into the season we can t dock a team for simply taking care of business we need to laud them in the any given sunday atmosphere of the nfl it s impressive when a good team does what it s supposed to jacksonville had its stumble in week 6 with its loss to a disappointing texans squad but thursday served as a microcosm of the jaguars year so far trevor lawrence is playing mvp caliber ball using an assortment of talented skill position options to aplomb all while the defense and special teams play terrifically as well pomp and circumstance have hardly been prevalent but lopsided wins have thursday night showed these jaguars are ready for prime time and long overdue for recognition as an nfl heavyweight ravens are reeling it s pouring down in baltimore the rain the boos the losses they were all coming down on thursday night as baltimore lost its fourth in a row it was no doubt an uphill climb trying to topple one of the afc s best with an undrafted free agent quarterback joe fagnano under center it s just not that simple though baltimore had five accepted penalties for 31 yards in the first half to set a horrible tone the offensive game plan was clearly to milk the clock get creative and use smoke and mirrors to help fagnano find his way derrick henry took some snaps at quarterback attempted a pass and there was plenty of trickery in the backfield but it played out like a plan to lose by a slimmer margin rather than trying to go out swinging looking for a win fagnano attempted one pass all night of more than 10 yards as the offense drew boos and gained little baltimore s defense rookie head coach jesse minter s calling card hardly stood up to the occasion continuing a campaign in which it s been a massive letdown baltimore allowed seven scoring drives the injuries to lamar jackson and tyler huntley are overwhelming the offensive line has been ravaged by injuries as well heck kicker tyler loop is on injured reserve too veteran quarterback jacoby brissett is reportedly joining the fray in the coming days but more than the qb position needs saving here though brissett should open up the playbook more than it was on thursday he hasn t started a game for a team that made the playoffs since his 2016 rookie season with the patriots minter was tasked with leading a super bowl contender to turn the corner and those best aspirations are getting washed away in a hurry jaguars d tears up ravens the no 2 defense in points allowed heading into week 9 the jaguars shut down the ravens offense allowing three points on baltimore s first drive and nothing for the next nine possessions until justice hill broke loose for a 65 yard touchdown run baltimore had just 227 yards of offense 10 first downs and was 4 of 14 on third down the basic stats and arithmetic were ugly jacksonville racked up three takeaways an interception by montaric brown another pick by jourdan lewis and a fumble recovery on a kickoff return despite losing defensive tackle davon hamilton for the season earlier in the week the no 1 rushing defense held the line against derrick henry confining him to 57 yards on 17 carries the pass rush has been problematic for the jags and it wasn t great on thursday generating a 30 pressure rate but it really made no matter jacksonville has now won four games in which it s held an opponent to 10 points or less trevor just keeps getting it done with time winding down chants of trev er lore ence broke out at m t bank stadium jaguars fans had taken over with disgruntled ravens fans leaving for drier and less frustrating ground lawrence finished the evening completing 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards and a 50 yard touchdown to parker washington it s anything but a flashy stat line but this was an ugly night weather wise and the ravens did their best to slow play things lawrence s mvp candidacy remains alive he s hardly the front runner but he s the face and symbol of an ascending afc power there isn t all that much sizzle but there s plenty of substance this wasn t a game for big fantasy pleasing numbers just results that really matter lawrence who hasn t thrown an interception in 10 quarters completed throws to eight pass catchers and finished with a 105 0 passer rating his qb rating sits at a league high 111 7 after thursday just ahead of joe burrow 111 6 lawrence is getting it done in splendid if not spectacular fashion and the jags are following his lead which is currently a very healthy advantage in the afc south life without lamar it s never easy playing without your starting quarterback much less when it s lamar jackson a transcendent talent and two time ap nfl most valuable player unfortunately it s not been an uncommon occurrence having returned from an ankle sprain last week only to be lost likely for the season with a thumb injury the ravens have to soldier forward without him and backup tyler huntley who is out for the season thursday dropped baltimore s record to 7 14 without jackson since he took over the starting reins for the club in 2018 now with jackson on injured reserve and his season all but officially over his future with the franchise has become a prevailing topic and it won t cease being a discussion point anytime soon the ravens and jackson couldn t work out an extension this offseason and the final year of his current contract is 2027 his age 30 season and one in which his contract poses an 84 34 million cap hit before any of that is resolved the ravens still have another nine games in the regular season over the last four in which jackson played one snap total derrick henry has rushed for less than 60 yards in each game there is a domino effect unsurprisingly without jackson the future beyond this year is unclear and the rest of this one is increasingly murky next gen stats insight for jaguars ravens via nfl pro ravens qb joe fagnano was 0 for 1 on downfield passes 10 plus air yards trevor lawrence completed eight of his 10 downfield attempts for 193 yards and a touchdown against the ravens his most downfield passing yards in a game and second highest downfield completion rate 80 of the season nfl research derrick henry was held to 57 yards on thursday but he improved to 13 707 in his career surpassing hall of famers jerome bettis 13 662 yards ninth place all time and ladainian tomlinson 13 684 eighth to move into seventh place on all time in rushing yards

news_mentions.headline: Colts HC not limiting Jonathan Taylor's workload amid trade rumors: 'He wants to go win this game'
news_mentions.description: The biggest fish on the Colts' roster is running back Jonathan Taylor, whose name continues to circulate ahead of next week's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: indianapolis launched a fire sale last week sending two key players defensive tackle deforest buckner and guard quenton nelson to nfc title contenders and recouping draft capital while both are big names neither is the biggest fish on the colts roster that title belongs to running back jonathan taylor whose name continues to circulate ahead of next tuesday s trade deadline indianapolis could move him for the right price he s under a recently signed contract extension meaning he ll be under team control with his next employer should the colts trade him he s also still at the peak of his powers as one of the nfl s best running backs the colts aren t interested in solely playing the market though coach shane steichen told reporters wednesday ahead of their week 9 game against the cowboys that he isn t limiting taylor s workload amid trade rumors despite the fact a standard amount of carries could expose him to a greater risk of injury and thus diminished return if the colts trade him i think there s a lot of stuff out there right now but he s on our football team and he s excited for this opportunity to play he wants to go win this game steichen said via the associated press there s a lot of hypotheticals out there on the trade talks right now but he s on our football team to taylor s credit he isn t taking any plays off or letting his mind wander to a possible next destination the running back has explained in detail how he and his colts teammates are approaching the remainder of the season following the firing of general manager chris ballard and beginning steps of an anticipated roster teardown teams are going to look at us even more foaming at the mouth taylor said after indy s week 8 loss in jacksonville your back is against the wall what are you going to do you re going to have to fight your way out of a corner this is not getting nowhere near any easier you ve got to accept that and when you accept that that s just the first step despite the downturn indianapolis isn t shipping out every valuable player the colts received but have not fulfilled receiver josh downs trade request and he played in last sunday s defeat and they have since extended rising star defensive tackle adetomiwa adebawore on a two year deal reportedly worth 35 million but as he approaches his 28th birthday in january taylor isn t quite in the early stages of his career that would make him a guaranteed part of the colts future inspiring trade rumblings for now the colts will continue as constructed until told otherwise by the front office that could change with a phone call in the next week of course but it s all steichen s squad can do amid the uncertainty i think all the guys that are on our football team are getting ready to go play a football game he said those are the conversations i ve had with those guys in the front office that we re going out to try to go win a football game right now that s where we re at

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 8 games: Cardinals bench QB Jacoby Brissett vs. Cowboys
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 8 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 8 sunday arizona cardinals quarterback gardner minshew replaced jacoby brissettin the second half of sunday s win over dallas brissett was 10 of 23 for 119 yards and an interception at the time of his benching with arizona trailing 17 3 running back jeremiyah love ankle left early and did not return running back bam knight concussion and wide receiver kendrick bourne ankle were ruled out baltimore ravens quarterback lamar jackson right thumb was ruled out from sunday s game against buffalo jackson needs surgery on his injured thumb and will be placed on injured reserve coach jesse minter said after the game qb tyler huntley was also ruled out and suffered what is thought to be a turf toe injury per espn s adam schefter huntley is expected to undergo an mri on monday schefter reported buffalo bills wide receiver josh palmer hamstring was ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore chicago bears linebackers coach richard smith will not travel with the team to seattle for monday s game against the seahawks due to a health issue the team announced assistant linebackers coach kevin koch will handle lb coach duties per the team cincinnati bengals defensive end cashius howell right wrist and defensive end cedric johnson left ankle were ruled out of sunday s win over tennessee cleveland browns defensive tackle maliek collins elbow did not return to sunday s loss to pittsburgh dallas cowboys tight end jake ferguson ankle was ruled out of sunday s loss to arizona cornerback joey porter ankle did not return while safety caleb downs was evaluated for a concussion and ruled out detroit lions linebacker jack campbell was transported to a local hospital to be evaluated for a neck injury suffered in the second half of sunday s win over minnesota the team announced campbell is resting and will remain in the hospital on sunday night for continued evaluation and monitoring campbell left the field on a stretcher after suffering the injury center cade mays ankle running back jacob saylors neck edge rusher d j wonnum concussion and safety brian branch concussion also were ruled out cornerback d j reed hip did not return jacksonville jaguars defensive tackle davon hamilton knee and safety eric murray elbow were ruled out from sunday s win over indianapolis kansas city chiefs defensive lineman peter woods neck was ruled out of sunday s loss to the broncos las vegas raiders cornerback darien porter groin was ruled out of sunday s win over the jets los angeles rams cornerback jaylen watson shoulder was ruled out of sunday s win over the chargers cornerback trent mcduffie back did not return to the game minnesota vikings safety theo jackson quad was ruled out of sunday s loss to detroit philadelphia eagles defensive back michael carter abdomen did not return to sunday night s loss against the commanders tampa bay buccaneers linebacker yaya diaby knee was ruled out of sunday s win over atlanta washington commanders running back jeremy mcnichols foot did not return to sunday night s win against the eagles

news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

material_news_signals.headline: Colts HC not limiting Jonathan Taylor's workload amid trade rumors: 'He wants to go win this game'
material_news_signals.description: The biggest fish on the Colts' roster is running back Jonathan Taylor, whose name continues to circulate ahead of next week's trade deadline.
material_news_signals.body_text: indianapolis launched a fire sale last week sending two key players defensive tackle deforest buckner and guard quenton nelson to nfc title contenders and recouping draft capital while both are big names neither is the biggest fish on the colts roster that title belongs to running back jonathan taylor whose name continues to circulate ahead of next tuesday s trade deadline indianapolis could move him for the right price he s under a recently signed contract extension meaning he ll be under team control with his next employer should the colts trade him he s also still at the peak of his powers as one of the nfl s best running backs the colts aren t interested in solely playing the market though coach shane steichen told reporters wednesday ahead of their week 9 game against the cowboys that he isn t limiting taylor s workload amid trade rumors despite the fact a standard amount of carries could expose him to a greater risk of injury and thus diminished return if the colts trade him i think there s a lot of stuff out there right now but he s on our football team and he s excited for this opportunity to play he wants to go win this game steichen said via the associated press there s a lot of hypotheticals out there on the trade talks right now but he s on our football team to taylor s credit he isn t taking any plays off or letting his mind wander to a possible next destination the running back has explained in detail how he and his colts teammates are approaching the remainder of the season following the firing of general manager chris ballard and beginning steps of an anticipated roster teardown teams are going to look at us even more foaming at the mouth taylor said after indy s week 8 loss in jacksonville your back is against the wall what are you going to do you re going to have to fight your way out of a corner this is not getting nowhere near any easier you ve got to accept that and when you accept that that s just the first step despite the downturn indianapolis isn t shipping out every valuable player the colts received but have not fulfilled receiver josh downs trade request and he played in last sunday s defeat and they have since extended rising star defensive tackle adetomiwa adebawore on a two year deal reportedly worth 35 million but as he approaches his 28th birthday in january taylor isn t quite in the early stages of his career that would make him a guaranteed part of the colts future inspiring trade rumblings for now the colts will continue as constructed until told otherwise by the front office that could change with a phone call in the next week of course but it s all steichen s squad can do amid the uncertainty i think all the guys that are on our football team are getting ready to go play a football game he said those are the conversations i ve had with those guys in the front office that we re going out to try to go win a football game right now that s where we re at

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top
