news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Nov. 10's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: with the 2026 nfl trade deadline set for nov 10 nfl com s kevin patra breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season ravens add journeyman qb after jackson huntley injured date of trade nov 6 baltimore receives qb jacoby brissett 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b arizona receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 seventh round draft pick grade b sometimes even in the nfl trades make too much sense not to happen when the ravens lost both lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury all eyes turned to jacoby brissett whom the arizona cardinals had just benched days later we get a trade baltimore had to make a move jesse minters squad found itself floating up the creek without either paddle forced to steer with a soup spoon it would have been unfair to joe fagnano and the rest of the team to ride the undrafted rookie the rest of the way as we saw thursday night fagnano is simply outmatched right now the free agent options offered little better enter brissett the 33 year old journeyman joins his seventh team in seven seasons he should be able to get up to speed quickly having his former qb coach israel woolfork in baltimore makes the transition easier after sitting out the offseason in an effort to get a reworked contract brissett struggled to fit into mike lafleur s offense he s been a bottom quarter passer this season ranking 18th of 23 qbs in epa per dropback at 0 11 min 200 attempts his stats are down across the board from last season when he finished with 3 366 yards a 23 8 td int ratio a 94 1 passer rating and a 0 05 epa per dropback there is a reason brissett has bounced around there is also a reason he keeps winding up a starter brissett s not the ideal franchise setter but he s a solid addition to a floundering ravens squad that has lost four straight games the hope is that he fits in declan doyle s offense better and gets back to the distributing ways we saw last season the price is about right for a player who was benched the ravens don t currently own any non compensatory fifth or sixth round picks in 2027 so a middle round swap with a 2028 final round sweetener was about as best as they could do it s not great to spend assets to solve a problem on a sinking ship but baltimore couldn t move forward with what it had on the slim chance brissett turns things around and pushes the ravens to the playoffs it was worth the small price the cardinals paid a couple million dollars to move on from their third string qb for a day 3 draft swap and a 2028 dart throw it s not significant capital but it s better than nothing i wonder if they might have received more by waiting until monday to see if another club minnesota jumped into the fray but arizona couldn t let the deadline pass without moving the veteran it was clear brissett was done in the desert after sunday s comeback win from gardner minshew the presence of the mania inducing veteran along with rookie carson beck made brissett superfluous in hindsight arizona probably should have moved on from brissett in the offseason while he was seeking a pay bump i understand why they didn t but he was always going to be a stopgap having two bridges to some unknown land is hardly good asset usage in that view i can t give the cards a rave review but getting even a minor upgrade in the draft is positive and if the ravens continue to spiral even with brissett that fourth rounder could be better bears trade two first rounders for all pro dt date of trade oct 29 chicago receives dt jeffery simmons 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b tennessee receives 2027 first round draft pick 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 first round draft pick grade a ryan poles finally upgraded the defensive line since may i ve been writing that the bears lack of action along the line whether adding a dt or pass rusher was head scratching the interior was particularly troubling as the bears have been counting on 33 year old grady jarrett and journeymen kentavius street neville gallimore and james lynch coordinator dennis allen has made it work but an upgrade was warranted before the operation collapsed poles never one to sit on his hands made a massive splash simmons is the type of game changing talent who could flip a playoff game in chicago s favor already an nfc favorite to make a postseason run the 5 2 bears have made a move that puts them squarely in the running to hoist a lombardi a beast among beasts simmons leads all defensive tackles with 28 quarterback pressures and is tied for second with four sacks notably he s racked up that production on a titans team that has been behind a lot this season imagine the numbers he d put up in game scripts that force more passes from the offense we re about to find out the 29 year old isn t just a get up the field fly wildly at the quarterback defensive tackle either no no no simmons is a wrecking ball to whatever unfortunate soul might be clutching the pigskin when he s on the warpath in addition to owning the most qb pressures among dts he also is tied for second with 21 run stops and tied for third with seven run stuffs per next gen stats there has been some chatter that his play has waned this season in tennessee i don t buy it if you haven t seen the man with the red armband manically flying around the field in tennessee this season you haven t been watching simmons has been every bit as good as any interior defender this season in the chicago spotlight he could push his way into the dpoy conversation the move could tip the balance of the nfc north and the entire conference in the bears favor that s how good simmons is from a pure player addition standpoint it s a home run for poles the issue is the compensation two first round picks and a fourth rounder is a massive haul it s also notable that the fifth round pick the bears got back with simmons is in 2028 not 2027 two first rounders for a non quarterback is a huge cost i understand why poles was willing to do it with most of his key players on rookie contracts now it was the time to strike however after he pays all those guys including quarterback caleb williams he ll need good players on cheap rookie deals to keep things rolling recent non quarterbacks traded for multiple first round picks include edge rusher micah parsons cornerback sauce gardner offensive tackle laremy tunsil safety jamal adams and edge khalil mack to chicago in 2018 that s a mixed bag of results if i m being kind and some outright cringey mistakes including gardner last year a d lineman isn t a cb but it s still a hefty price for anyone who doesn t sling the oblong the bears doing this twice is notable mack didn t bring the bears a super bowl two playoff appearances however the situation feels different this time chicago has a clear franchise difference maker at quarterback the other recent comparable trade was the dallas cowboys sending a first and second rounder for interior defensive lineman quinnen williams at the deadline last season i should note that simmons is older than every single player i mentioned above was at the time of their trade how the dt ages will factor into what this trade looks like three years from now if there was a parade in downtown chicago before then the locals won t care about the cost of two firsts this was a no brainer for the titans two firsts for a non qb for a team that isn t one player away from contending in a heartbeat simmons was a leader and the squad s pulse but when you have that kind of offer you have to pull the trigger tennessee isn t a jeffery simmons away from being a perennial contender his next few years would have been spent withering away during yet another rebuild and he d have lost trade value it s going to stink for the rest of the locker room this year as robert saleh s team figures to continue struggling however that would be the case with or without simmons until second year qb cam ward morphs into a consistent difference maker not just a sometimes player the titans won t take a step forward if that doesn t happen tennessee will need all the first round picks it can get to find the next guy and give him the best chance to succeed colts part with another pro bowler get pick from 49ers date of trade oct 27 san francisco receives dl deforest buckner grade a indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick grade b we didn t have to wait long to find out how others in the nfc west would react to the seahawks splash move for quenton nelson hours later the 49ers bolstered their defensive interior by bringing back buckner whom they traded to indy in 2020 the reunion was telegraphed for weeks buckner clearly fed up with the mounting losses in indianapolis began voicing his displeasure couple that with the 49ers need along the defensive line and the move made almost too much sense the niners have the cap space to cover the remainder of buckner s contract assuming it s not adjusted and are all in after their first loss of the season buckner has 47 0 sacks since 2020 tied for second among defensive tackles behind only chris jones 55 122 qb hits 420 tackles and 312 qb pressures the big man can still be a people mover on the interior however the 32 year old is showing some signs of a slide he generated four sacks in 10 games in 2025 his fewest since 2017 his pass rush percentages are also down a tick from the past couple of years he s generated an 8 3 qb pressure rate through seven games buckner was at 10 3 in 2025 and 11 7 in 2024 similarly his run stop rates have dipped as well going from 15 7 in 2024 to 15 6 in 2025 to 12 4 in 2026 is it age or can we just chalk the dips up to playing in a struggling defense for a losing team regardless of whether he s on the downturn buckner represents an upgrade in the middle of the 49ers battered defensive line paired with osa odighizuwa the niners now have two players who can push the pocket if buckner also boosts the interior run d probably the 49ers weakest spot at this point it will be a clear win for the niners the cost might be a tad much for an 11 year pro on the back nine of his career who could be a short term rental but a fourth rounder isn t exorbitant by any stretch it s the type of move a team like the 49ers in a super bowl window should make i ll reward aggression with day 3 draft picks when it nets a good player who can make a difference in a playoff run buckner was probably the most obvious asset the colts had that was going to be moved he was in the final year of his contract clearly unhappy and any compensatory pick they could have received back would have been at most a fifth rounder in 2028 due to how long he s been in the league if he even signs a deal big enough to qualify in 2027 getting a fourth rounder in 2027 out of that is a win for indy the colts need as many lotto tickets as possible for the next general manager i d expect ed dodds to listen to offers on any of his pending free agents and potentially others under contract beyond 2027 the only real issue with the oct 27 deal is that as with nelson the colts might have gotten more for buckner possibly a late round sweetener by shopping him around for another two weeks even with that qualification i still like the return indy got in this swap seahawks acquire eight time pro bowl guard from colts date of trade oct 27 seattle receives g quenton nelson grade a indianapolis receives 2027 third round draft pick 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b the seahawks had some sneaky issues along the offensive line despite entering the season with the same five that helped win a super bowl while the run game concerns have mostly been pinned on the running backs the blocking has struggled to open holes on 184 rb carries the seahawks have just 92 yards before contact this season per next gen stats and they ve been stuffed 37 times that s not the type of offense mike macdonald wants to employ yes getting zach charbonnet and jadarian price back healthy could have helped but general manager john schneider went to cure the root cause nelson is an eight time pro bowl guard who is still playing at a hall of fame level the 30 year old can open holes in the run game is a weapon as a puller and is superior as a pass protector in eight seasons in indy he allowed no more than eight qb hits in a single season per pff the seahawks just added the nfl s most complete guard how will the rest of the nfc west respond the addition will immediately help sam darnold keeping the qb clean will go a long way toward negating some of the wayward interceptions adding nelson also aids whoever lines up at left tackle where starter charles cross is expected to miss a week or two with a high ankle sprain importing the left guard will bump second year player grey zabel to right guard where he played in college and where seattle has had trouble for a while anthony bradford struggled even during the super bowl run the price for seattle is excellent given that it s expected to get a slew of compensatory picks in 2027 nelson being on an expiring deal also helps if he leaves for a big deal the seahawks would be in line for another comp pick in 2028 we ve seen schneider re sign players acquired in season as well leonard williams and rashid shaheed so it s not guaranteed to be a rental for the seahawks either it s not every day you can snag a future hall of famer to fill a significant hole without giving up a pick in the top two rounds i was somewhat surprised indy couldn t get a second round pick back given the overwhelming need across the league along the offensive line but we know that gms are stingier in season then become drunken sailors on draft day so maybe i shouldn t be so amazed i can t blame the colts for moving any and all assets to recoup chris ballard s mistakes but i wonder if they d have gotten more by waiting until closer to the deadline without a first round pick which right now would be in the top 10 and a roster riddled with holes the next general manager needs as much ammo as possible stripping down the roster will only make the sauce gardner trade sting even more given nelson s status as a pending free agent the colts could have waited and let him walk in free agency but the compensation would have been a third round pick max in 2028 this trade allows them to get the pick a year earlier and adds a fifth round sweetener trading away their best player two weeks before the trade deadline suggests a teardown is in play indy should be very active over the next fortnight and you can bet any gm with a need is going to put in a call to colts interim gm ed dodds cards deal former no 4 pick to texans date of trade oct 12 houston receives wr marvin harrison 2027 sixth round draft pick grade c arizona receives 2027 second round draft pick 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b when the trade details came through i assumed it was a typo that the texans shipped a 2027 second round pick for a player who was clearly out of the rotation in arizona my brain rationalized it as a 2028 second rounder or a 2027 fourth rounder nope the texans paid a premium pick in the upcoming draft for a shot at revitalizing harrison s career the cards reportedly had made it known they were holding out for a second round pick the moment the texans upped their bid to a second in 2027 they pounced i don t fault arizona for moving on right now in four games in 2026 harrison caught five passes on 13 targets for 85 yards and one touchdown that s like a half of one game for the upper echelon of wrs harrison has generated 0 6 yards per route run this year the third lowest among players with at least 100 routes per next gen stats basically harrison has been doing little more than a cardio workout on sundays getting a second rounder is solid work the grade isn t higher because the same brass that acquired that asset used the no 4 overall pick on harrison in 2024 monti ossenfort still gets docked for whiffing on a prime selection i understand why the texans would take a swing on harrison like most of the league they probably gave the ohio state product a very high pre draft grade reuniting him with former buckeyes teammate c j stroud could bring out the best in the wideout the texans have struggled mightily to move the ball when nico collins has been injured and given collins history and the hard hits he takes he s not guaranteed to make it through the rest of the season without missing time after laying an egg for four weeks the 1 4 texans don t have any more wiggle room harrison s contract isn t onerous giving houston some insurance if tank dell never returns to form or jayden higgins is delayed next year coming off a season ending injury in the short term this trade is somewhat duplicative of the much cheaper deal in which it acquired kayshon boutte it s more costly but gives the club more control of the future mostly i don t love the price tag for a player who hasn t been who we thought he was for it to make sense to give up a day 2 pick the texans need harrison to finally break out after two mediocre seasons perhaps in improved surroundings and on a team that clearly wants him with a qb he knows and trusts harrison can blossom frankly i probably like many scouts can t figure out the disconnect between a player who looked as polished and well rounded as harrison did at osu and the one we ve seen lope about for two plus years the question is whether you believe the scouting or the two separate coaching staffs who haven t found much use for him the texans are betting on their scouting eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 9 fantasy sleepers: Giants QB J.J. McCarthy, Cowboys WR Ryan Flournoy offer upside
news_mentions.description: Could J.J. McCarthy solve your roster woes at quarterback? Raza Umerani highlights 10 sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 9.
news_mentions.body_text: we ve reached the point in the fantasy football season where it s time to do a pulse check nearly half of the teams in the league have had their bye week there s a solid grasp on which players are weekly starts and whom we might have to permanently park on the bench if not drop we know when we might be getting our stars back we also know that some of them might miss the rest of the season commiserations lamar jackson managers so what s the pulse of your team are you staring down the consolation bracket and considering trading off your top draft pick are you atop the standings and meticulously monitoring every move your leaguemates make are you oscillating in and out of the playoff picture and still can t decide which jets receiver to start this week no matter what your hypothetical fantasy bpm is the sleepers column is here to help there s no tanking in this game we play which means we have to do whatever it takes to get another win here s to hoping these hidden gems get you there note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: Browns' Shedeur Sanders to start at QB vs. Saints with Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol
news_mentions.description: Shedeur Sanders will make his first start of the 2026 season on Sunday for Cleveland against the Saints, replacing Deshaun Watson, who remains in concussion protocol.
news_mentions.body_text: the browns offense will look a bit different in week 9 shedeur sanders will make his first start of the 2026 season on sunday for cleveland against the new orleans saints replacing deshaun watson who remains in concussion protocol browns coach todd monken said he hasn t decided whether watson will be active if he does clear protocol by sunday he s still not able to do team reps monken said of watson he can do individual he can do some routes been in meetings but you re not able to do any of the team reps which makes it difficult watson was limited in his return to practice friday and is officially listed as questionable to play sanders will be tasked with leading an offense that gained 319 yards last week but scored just six points in a 27 6 defeat in pittsburgh cleveland 5 3 needs to keep pace in the afc north as it s slipped to third entering week 9 with the steelers 6 2 atop the division and the bengals 5 2 residing in second a 2025 fifth round pick out of colorado sanders took over as cleveland s starter in the back half of the 2025 season appearing in eight games seven starts and posting a 3 4 record while completing 56 6 of his passes for 1 400 yards and a 7 10 td int ratio while producing positive moments sanders first season concluded with plenty of questions to answer and a lack of firm evidence he d be capable of taking over as the browns long term answer under center sanders lost the preseason quarterback battle to watson who has played well in his first action since his season ending injury in 2024 watson had back to back 300 yard games and has led five game winning drives this year tied for the most in the league but also took a league high 33 sacks watson is now slated to miss at least a game in each of his seasons with the browns who acquired him in a trade with the texans ahead of the 2022 campaign watson s eight starts this year are already a career high for him as a brown if watson ends up being inactive sanders will be backed up by 2025 third round pick dillon gabriel the 24 year old sanders has made two appearances this season completing all three of his pass attempts for 2 yards cleveland kicks off against the saints at 1 p m et on sunday in the unfriendly confines of the caesars superdome

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 9 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Will the Bengals stay hot in a potential shootout against the Falcons in Madrid? Who wins an enticing interconference showdown between the Packers and Patriots? Which 6-1 squad prevails on Monday night: Buffalo or Minnesota? Check out the Week 9 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 9 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 2 p m et on thursday nov 5 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday nov 8 why gennaro picked the bengals joe burrow and michael penix are both coming off career days burrow notched a career best six total touchdowns in an overtime win penix threw a career worst four interceptions in a rain soaked loss but i m not here today to talk about either quarterback rather i d like to spotlight a bengals receiver and it isn t the one we usually fawn over yes this is a tee higgins appreciation blurb typically overshadowed by perennial pro bowler ja marr chase higgins currently ranks second in the nfl behind only jaxon smith njigba with 636 receiving yards putting him on pace for nearly 1 800 yards on the season the 6 foot 4 220 pounder has always been a beast at the catch point but he s become a true monster after the catch this season owning a career high rate in missed tackles forced 27 9 per next gen stats in related news nfl research tells me that burrow and higgins comfortably boast the highest passer rating of any qb wr combo in the league min 45 targets at 132 3 of course burrow and chase still rank fifth in that category at 113 6 leading me to the larger point here we ve all been saying cincinnati has two wr1s for years nowadays that almost feels like an undersell the bengals have two of the most frightening offensive weapons in the league at the moment with higgins 10 155 2 and chase 11 141 1 both posting primo stat lines last sunday and this week they draw an atlanta cb group that s been marred by injuries and inconsistency in a potential shootout on the international stage give me the league s best receiving duo why gennaro picked the panthers riding a four game win streak denver has shot to the top of the afc west and yet there are still plenty of reasons to doubt these broncos the offense quite frankly is boring well until bo nix decides to put together a game winning drive and the defense while solid in some of the advanced statistics just hasn t been the shutdown unit of the past two seasons ranking 20th against the pass 25th against the run and 25th on third down yes denver s a perfect 4 0 at home compiling an impressive collection of victories over the jaguars rams seahawks and chiefs but this week s game is in charlotte and away from mile high the broncos have been rather unremarkable beating the also rans chargers cardinals and losing to the contenders chiefs 49ers which brings us to the panthers are they an also ran or a contender honestly it s kind of hard to say despite being below 500 they currently sit atop a dull nfc south and while they opened october with an impressive win over the lions they closed the month with one sided defeats to the buccaneers and packers consequently this feels like a midseason hinge game especially with carolina set to hit the road in three of the next four weeks now it s possible denver s pass rush just overwhelms carolina s battered offensive line and the firing of dc ejiro evero could either spark or spike the panthers defense but with carolina having a few extra days to recuperate and regroup following last week s appearance on thursday night football i envision dave canales rallying his plucky team to a narrow home win over a broncos squad that currently feels far closer to 6 3 than 7 2 why jeremy picked the cowboys it s a matchup of fire sale vs fire everybody the colts and cowboys are entering sunday s game at arguably the lowest points of each of their seasons indy is more focused on the trade deadline than the play between the lines despite what shane steichen has to say dallas is coming off an unthinkable choke job at home against the cardinals casting doubt on whether it can really compete in a limp nfc east something s gotta give jonathan taylor is set up for a big day against dallas the 32nd ranked run defense in the league but the colts rb has recently been corralled by opposing defenses while trade rumors swirl the more defining matchup sunday will be whether indianapolis can slow down dak prescott ceedee lamb and george pickens who can put up yards and points against the colts 30th ranked scoring defense with javonte williams getting good touches against the league s least efficient run defense the cowboys should wrangle the colts on sunday unless their lasso loosens in the second half again why dan picked the chiefs while both teams enter week 9 on a losing streak there are not many games that could offer a better get right environment to the chiefs than a meeting with the jets at home kansas city s offense has taken a step back with injury woes at receiver and defenses bottling up kenneth walker but gang green should offer far less resistance than seattle and denver did in the last two weeks aaron glenn s crew has allowed 30 7 points per game in its three game losing streak second most in the league during that span no team has allowed more epa per dropback over the last two weeks than new york 0 53 and that was against the likes of malik willis and kirk cousins glenn s offense is coming off a season high 33 point performance but geno smith might be without his top weapon garrett wilson who is in the concussion protocol it s been more than two years since the jets won on the road against an above 500 team and it would take a very uninspired performance from patrick mahomes and co to end that skid on sunday editor s update on friday jets coach aaron glenn said garrett wilson will not play in sunday s game why bobby picked the lions miami has played better after its week 6 bye beating the jets and then holding an ill fated double digit halftime lead over the patriots but detroit also seems to be finding its stride after going 2 2 over the first month of the season with the two wins feeling far more contested than the losses the lions have now rattled off three consecutive victories detroit s achilles heel the defense has improved during the winning streak the lions have allowed their three lowest point totals and three lowest yardage totals of the season in the past three contests giving up a per game average of 17 7 points and 305 7 yards since week 5 compared to 31 8 points and 423 8 yards in weeks 1 4 it s a touch dramatic to call a nov 8 game for a 5 2 team a must win but that s how brutal the nfc north is the lions simply can t afford to drop a game against a one win team when they have four tough divisional matchups still to go plus dates with the patriots a resurgent buccaneers club a falcons team that knocked the 49ers off their unbeaten perch and the nfc east leading giants they know that and as the superior squad they ll play like it why brooke picked the saints shedeur sanders is in line to start for the browns with deshaun watson who was playing his best ball since 2020 entering concussion protocol earlier this week the biggest difference with sanders under center appears to be his willingness to stretch the field as his average of 7 1 air yards per target in 2025 trumps watson s 6 7 mark through eight games this season sanders is also working with better receivers than he did a year ago with rookies denzel boston and kc concepcion earning big roles in todd monken s offense none of that will ultimately matter if the run game is dormant as it was last week 34 yards in pittsburgh the saints defense has been anything but great against the run allowing 139 4 rush yards per game 29th in the nfl and giving up north of 100 yards in all but one game in 2026 but i do see this being a get right game for new orleans on all fronts with the saints fresh off the bye changes were made to the run game firing run game coordinator t j paganetti signing rb audric estim 233 and the kicking ranks charlie smyth is expected to handle duties after daniel carlson s release and the entire roster got a little healthier first round receiver jordyn tyson returned to practice and could be a boon if he does indeed make his nfl debut this week for tyler shough opposite chris olave getting kelvin banks back along an o line that has struggled to keep shough clean in the pocket will significantly benefit kellen moore s unit whenever banks returns to game action sanders can smile all he wants but the saints will get the last laugh sunday why jeremy picked the giants in a meeting of former michigan men j j mccarthy and joe milton backups on other franchises in september will renew one of the nfl s fiercest rivalries to kick off november mccarthy will get his second start leading the giants offense while milton on his third team will see his first ever nfl start for philadelphia after being called on to replace an ineffective tanner mckee the g men have played close games under john harbaugh they ve entered the last minute of each of their tilts separated on one score or less save for the rams debacle and this one should be no different even against a beat up eagles side philly historically plays new york well at home the giants have dropped 12 straight at a hostile lincoln financial field and the infusion of milton to the offense could provide a spark for nick sirianni s squad milton is a bomb thrower averaging the second most air yards per attempt since 2024 min 50 attempts in his relief appearances mccarthy has had a similar run of play in his six quarters with big blue helping make malik nabers the reigning offensive player of the month there will be big plays and maybe bigger mistakes made in sunday s game but unlike the injury riddled eagles the 26 giants know how to win tight tussles and should ride the amtrak back to new jersey victorious why jeremy picked the rams sean mcvay will coach the rams in landover on sunday for the first time in front of a home crowd since he left for los angeles in 2017 after three years as washington s oc mcvay s rams made this long trip east in 2020 but that year never happened if you think about it mcvay returns to the nation s capital at a critical juncture with the once super bowl favorites at 4 4 but on a two game winning streak the commanders are also amid a midseason turnaround after a get right win out of the bye over the wounded eagles but jayden daniels and co may be running into a buzzsaw in a rams defense that could return myles garrett who was back at practice this week if the reigning dpoy is in the lineup he will line up alongside three time dpoy aaron donald for the first time since both joined the rams this offseason perhaps it ll be the straw that breaks opponents backs donald has yet to log a sack this season daniels has played carefully since his injury he hasn t thrown a pick this season and washington has just three giveaways on the year the qb may need to let it loose sunday to keep up with matthew stafford and the fourth ranked rams offense this one will be closer than most expect but l a presents a much more difficult task for the commanders than tanner mckee s eagles editor s update on friday nfl network s mike garafolo and ian rapoport reported that myles garrett knee is expected to play on sunday why dan picked the texans when the chargers take the field on sunday it will have been nearly a full month since they last scored a touchdown yes there was a bye week during that stretch but they ve still gone nine full quarters without putting the ball in the end zone scoring just 15 points five field goals in that span in other words woof now the texans have been nearly as disappointing as their week 9 opponent last we saw houston it was being overpowered in overtime by a j j mccarthy led offense to fall to 2 5 demeco ryans squad enjoys a rest advantage though coming off a bye and has done a respectable job of putting points on the board thanks to a reassuring year 4 showing from c j stroud that flies a bit under the radar because of the team s struggles the outlook might be bleak for the texans right now but if they have any hope of salvaging their season they cannot let the chargers win their first game since dec 21 2025 why brooke picked the 49ers the raiders snapped their four game skid with a road victory over the jets parlaying that into two straight ws isn t likely as they head to santa clara to face the 49ers it s true that san francisco struggled big time with turnovers prior to the bye with the offense coughing up eight giveaways in the last three games and christian mccaffrey and mike evans are still dealing with injuries it s also true that these niners have the advantage in most major categories per nfl pro the two exceptions are overall passing efficiency and pressure rate when the raiders offense and 49ers defense share the field enter nick bosa who s in line to play for the first time since sept 20 and deforest buckner whom gm john lynch brought back to san francisco during the break per next gen stats when aligned as a dt buckner recorded four sacks tied for second most at the position 15 pressures tied for 16th six quick pressures tied for ninth and eight quarterback hits tied for fourth through the first seven weeks of the season despite being double teamed 83 times as a pass rusher tied for seventh most among dts in addition he has one missed tackle on 32 tackle attempts tied for the fewest at the position among those with 25 or more attempts buckner s addition should pay dividends for san francisco moving forward beginning sunday against the visiting raiders why brooke picked the patriots the packers and patriots have had the same results every week of the 2026 season and i pray they don t follow suit in week 9 because that would mean a dreaded tie please no these clubs have won four of their last five games significantly improving upon their rocky starts and feature many similar aspects including top 10 defenses the countdown to micah parsons return to game action is on and quarterbacks who aren t afraid to heave it deep green bay s jordan love leads the nfl with 21 completions of 25 plus yards and downfield pass yards 1 253 in 2026 per next gen stats new england s drake maye sits third in both categories but first in pass tds of 40 plus yards four so we should expect some explosive plays come sunday regardless of which pass catchers are healthy enough to take the field the one area that continues to trip me up is the packers run game that unit welcomed josh jacobs back from the commissioner s exempt list two games ago and nothing s changed green bay s averaging an nfl worst 60 6 rush yards per game in 2026 which would be the fewest by any team in a season since the 1970 merger and a ghastly 2 9 yards per carry i m not confident that changes sunday against a new england defense allowing the sixth fewest rush yards per game 92 6 it s a weakness the packers have been able to overcome in past weeks but it ll catch up to them this time why gennaro picked the seahawks in their first game of this season the cardinals upset the overrated chargers only to be smashed by the sam darnold less seahawks on the following sunday in their first game of this month the cardinals upset the overrated cowboys and look who s on the slate this sunday the sam darnold less seahawks with darnold sidelined this week by a fresh quad injury seattle plans to roll out drew lock against the cards once again as long as the backup qb isn t hindered by a recent elbow issue lock performed admirably in his winning spot start at arizona back in week 2 tossing three touchdown passes to jaxon smith njigba in an efficient outing that saw him complete over 73 of his throws and post a dazzling 139 1 passer rating can the second stringer log a second win over this division rival with jsn at his disposal and seattle s defense on his side lock doesn t have to play hero especially against an arizona team pulling its own levers at quarterback gardner minshew has taken the job from baltimore bound jacoby brissett do i believe in minshew mania well as a nothing to lose late game endeavor against the cowboys moribund defense sure but in the journeyman s first start of the season at seattle against the league s top ranked defense with the seahawks fresh off a humbling nationally televised home loss not so much mania is a fleeting sensation why dan picked the bears i believe the clock is about to strike midnight on the bucs recent cinderella like run after an 0 4 start to the season their recipe for success is not sustainable long term they won by 30 points a couple weeks ago despite throwing for just 64 yards and then they were victorious last week in a rain soaked game where they didn t complete a single pass becoming the first team since the 1974 buffalo bills to do so meanwhile the bears have planted their flag as legit contenders with prime time wins at home against the reigning afc champion patriots and on the road versus the reigning super bowl champion seahawks in consecutive weeks the defense is operating on a different level with trade acquisition jeffery simmons wreaking havoc and caleb williams is generating mvp chatter tampa bay s defense will be the best unit williams has faced since leaving chicago s week 2 loss to the vikings with the hamstring injury that sidelined him for three full games but i think it will take multiple takeaways by todd bowles group to jeopardize the bears winning streak the home team has more paths to victory than the bucs do right now monday nov 9 why bobby picked the bills with kyler murray battling a hamstring injury carson wentz is starting this game for the vikings frankly that development doesn t really change my feelings about this matchup which never hinged on the home team s quarterback minnesota s best chance at coming away with a victory will be to blitz josh allen into oblivion and hope it disrupts buffalo s offense enough to result in a low scoring slugfest defensive coordinator brian flores as everyone knows is very much up to that task his defense is blitzing at a rate of 71 0 which is 30 7 higher than the second ranked giants 40 3 per nfl pro for an idea of how absurd that is the gap between giants and the least blitz happy team bengals 18 9 is 21 4 compared to the rest of the league allen hasn t been particularly amazing against the blitz he is currently 20th out of 31 qualified quarterbacks with an 88 2 passer rating when facing extra rushers however that doesn t take into account the times he beats the blitz with his legs and running back james cook could also very well take some weight off allen s shoulders against a defense that is in the middle of the pack against the run while minnesota has allowed the fewest passing yards in the nfl it s giving up the 17th most rushing yards per game suffice it to say the bills will find a way to get theirs i m not so sure the vikings will which could result in a second straight loss to a premier offense they fail to keep up with thursday s game why bobby picked the jaguars jacksonville enters thursday night with the no 5 scoring offense and no 2 defense in points allowed while baltimore is limping into the prime time contest without star quarterback lamar jackson thumb for the long term not only that but backup tyler huntley is out for the season due to a turf toe injury there is a trade for jacoby brissett in the works but for at least one game the baton passes to undrafted rookie qb joe fagnano who went 10 of 21 for 91 yards and an interception after being thrust into the ravens week 8 loss to the bills as their emergency option will he improve enough to make a difference with an abbreviated week to prepare for his first ever nfl start it s hard to imagine especially facing a defense boasting the seventh highest pressure rate 39 6 in the league derrick henry has struggled during baltimore s three game losing streak he hasn t topped 58 yards rushing in news_mentions.headline: Ravens complete trade for Cardinals' Jacoby Brissett; deal terms revealed
news_mentions.description: The Arizona Cardinals have finalized a trade to send quarterback Jacoby Brissett to the Baltimore Ravens, the teams announced Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: the arizona cardinals have finalized a trade to send quarterback jacoby brissett to the baltimore ravens the teams announced friday baltimore is sending arizona a 2027 fourth round pick and 2028 seventh rounder in exchange for brissett and a 2027 fifth round selection nfl network s ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported the cardinals also paid more than half of brissett s remaining 2026 salary as part of the swap per rapoport the trade was initially reported on wednesday with the caveat that it would be finalized later in the week which has come to fruition cardinals head coach mike lafleur spoke to reporters on wednesday and stated he would let the process play out before confirming now the parties have come to terms in the aftermath of the ravens losing to the jacksonville jaguars on thursday night marking the third time in as many games baltimore had a different starting quarterback and its fourth consecutive loss undrafted free agent joe fagnano started against jacksonville after franchise qb lamar jackson started week 8 and injured his thumb on his first play back from missing time with an ankle injury in jackson s stead tyler huntley filled in as the starter but after relieving jackson against the buffalo bills huntley suffered a turf toe injury that has ended his season jackson meanwhile is on injured reserve and out indefinitely now the ravens winding road turns to brissett who presumably will start in week 10 against the los angeles chargers on monday night football brissett began this season his 11th in the nfl as arizona s qb1 he was benched following eight starts in favor of gardner minshew and shortly thereafter his trade to baltimore was reported so far in 2026 brissett has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 touchdowns and seven interceptions baltimore stands as his seventh nfl team new england patriots indianapolis colts miami dolphins cleveland browns washington commanders cardinals and will become the sixth for which he s started a game the ravens will look to rescue what s fast becoming a lost season as they owned a 12 playoff probability following thursday s defeat unfortunately for those odds brissett hasn t started a game for a playoff team since his rookie season of 2016 with the patriots the cardinals meanwhile will march forward with minshew starting and rookie carson beck in reserve and perhaps getting a shot later as lafleur s team looks to stay competitive and more importantly build for the future

news_mentions.headline: Eagles QB Joe Milton prepares for first start: NFL is about 'being ready when your name is called'
news_mentions.description: Joe Milton has never made an official start. Sunday, the former sixth-round pick will get his shot when the Philadelphia Eagles host the New York Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: joe milton has never made an official start sunday the former sixth round pick will get his shot when the philadelphia eagles host the new york giants milton said thursday that throughout his career as a backup he s been preparing for this chance i was just pretty much going through the plays going through the week like i was a starter or like i was playing and just being ready milton said via the philadelphia inquirer and that s what the nfl is about just being ready when your name is called and just preparing for those moments milton entered the league with the patriots and flashed athleticism during preseason action in week 18 2024 drake maye took the start but milton played the majority of the contest completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and rushing for another score last year he spent the season with dallas appearing in five games milton s last appearance was week 18 2025 for the cowboys when he played the entire second half versus the giants with dak prescott resting 7 13 73 pass yards one int 43 rush yards milton spent the offseason in dallas and while he showed promise again in preseason action the cowboys chose sam howell as prescott s backup milton signed to the dallas practice squad where the eagles plucked him on oct 16 after jalen hurts was placed on injured reserve due to blood clots milton was asked thursday how much of the eagles playbook he knows shoot whatever s in this week he said laughing milton is taking over for tanner mckee who has started the past three weeks the eagles offense has been a slog for most of the season during its six game skid since week 3 philly has been outgained by 889 yards worst in the nfl the hope is that milton can at least provide some pop to the limp unit he has averaged 10 2 air yards attempt since 2024 per next gen stats second most min 50 attempts both of milton s two career pass tds came on deep passes 20 air yds mckee told reporters he understood why he was benched and has been trying to help milton prepare he hasn t been here the whole time with training camp and some of those plays and so just talking to him about different reads different footwork things that we ve had a little more time on task doing here mckee said and so it s been great just communicating with him things that i ve seen in the past things that we ve learned from jalen or that offensive coordinator sean mannion has communicated in the past or things that we can reiterate to kind of slow his thinking down so he can just be free and be able to play like the great athlete he is the eagles hope that great athlete can wake up an offense that has struggled all season philly has gone three and out on 34 1 percent of drives the highest rate in the nfl and the highest in a season since the 2014 raiders 35 9 pct finished 3 13 the giants defense has forced a three and out on 32 9 percent of drives best in the nfl the eagles and giants kick off from lincoln financial field on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Ravens' play 'not acceptable' in latest blowout loss to Jaguars
news_mentions.description: The Baltimore Ravens lost their fourth straight contest, and third consecutive by 20-plus points.
news_mentions.body_text: it s getting ugly in baltimore the ravens got shellacked thursday night in a rain soaked 33 10 loss to the jacksonville jaguars it marked the first time in franchise history that baltimore haslost by 20 plus points in three consecutive games obviously it s a tough situation for our guys but i just told them there s no excuses there s no whatever we don t have this guy we don t have that guy coach jesse minter said after the loss the defense was out there it felt like the whole half i thought they battled and fought and did a decent job in the second half but obviously the results are not acceptable for us and what we re after losing quarterbacks lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury forced the ravens to start undrafted rookie joe fagnano on a short week the results were what you d expect the qb completed 10 of 18 passes for 60 yards threw two interceptions and took one sack the ravens rarely gave the rookie a chance to rip it and he didn t take it on the precious few early opportunities baltimore tried to lean on the ground game using derrick henry in the wildcat and copious amounts of misdirection you can dress up a ham sandwich with any number of accoutrements as you d like it s still a ham sandwich baltimore was held to 227 total yards and 10 first downs going 4 of 14 on third down and turning it over three times henry was slowed to 57 yards on 17 carries the soaked locals expressed their displeasure with loud halloween themed interjections before heading home early they have every right to boo or do whatever they want to do tight end mark andrews said obviously we re not used to this type of outcome it s not acceptable the lame duck offense will get the headlines but minter s defense has been among the most disappointing units in the entire nfl despite sporting pro bowl players at every level baltimore s d has been ripped up allowing 30 plus points in three straight games guys are frustrated defensive lineman calais campbell said but you got to take some pride in your work and you got to figure out a way at this point in time it s draw a line in the sand and decide where we go from here the offense not staying on the field surely has something to do with a defense that has morphed into a sieve the counter however is the opening drive a seven play touchdown march by the jags on thursday night on which the defense offered little resistance minter s defense has been average to below in nearly every statistical category this season thursday night when it was clear the offense would struggle with a backup qb in poor conditions the defense needed to carry the day previous iterations in baltimore would have instead the ravens broke it wasn t good enough we ve got to be better a clearly frustrated henry said it was the same story it wasn t good enough we ve got to be better with four straight losses sending them to 4 5 before a week 10 date with the current winless los angeles chargers they need to get a whole lot better fast to have any chance at saving the season

news_mentions.headline: Vikings to start Carson Wentz vs. Bills on Monday with Kyler Murray battling hamstring injury
news_mentions.description: The Minnesota Vikings will start quarterback Carson Wentz on Monday against the Buffalo Bills with Kyler Murray dealing with a hamstring injury, head coach Kevin O'Connell announced on Thursday.
news_mentions.body_text: a change is coming at quarterback for the vikings in week 9 carson wentz will start for minnesota in monday night s contest against the buffalo bills head coach kevin o connell told reporters on thursday kyler murray will miss the game due to a hamstring injury and is considered week to week per o connell max brosmer will assume backup duties behind wentz on monday o connell added the starting lineup swap doesn t come as a surprise after o connell told reporters on monday that murray was dealing with a sore hamstring following their week 8 loss to the detroit lions murray has had a challenging start to the 2026 season his first in minnesota with murray behind center for the majority of the season the vikings offense has struggled mightily ranking 29th in yards gained per game 31st in passing and 27th in points scored per contest 20 despite these issues the vikings own a 6 1 record entering week 9 thanks to the performance of an elite defense that ranks second in yards per game allowed and first in points per game allowed 13 3 minnesota s aggressive attacking defense has harassed opposing quarterbacks all season blitzing at a league high rate of 73 1 percent 30 5 percentage points higher than the next closest team and generating a qb pressure rate of 45 8 percent also the best in the nfl wentz certainly benefited from this defensive support in his two appearances one start earlier this season after murray suffered a concussion in the regular season opener the vikings won both games despite wentz finishing short of 150 passing yards in each contest in his two games played in 2026 the 33 year old quarterback has completed 23 of 39 passes for 276 yards and three touchdowns as o connell described it wentz s insertion into the starting lineup is only a temporary measure but if he succeeds at a rate higher than what vikings fans have begrudgingly come to accept from their team this season don t be surprised if a qb controversy arises in the near future

news_mentions.headline: Texans' Will Anderson: Justin Herbert 'playing out of his mind' for winless Chargers
news_mentions.description: Houston's Will Anderson Jr. will face Justin Herbert and the Chargers in Week 9 and is giving standard respect to his upcoming opponent -- even if it's, well, a bit inaccurate.
news_mentions.body_text: we re learning a lesson about how tone can change depending on timing take texans edge rusher will anderson he is part of a houston team that will face justin herbert and the chargers in week 9 and is giving standard respect to his upcoming opponent even if it s well a bit inaccurate he s still a really great quarterback in this league anderson said of herbert on wednesday you talk about a big guy that has a big arm that can run around that can throw the ball deep makes a lot of plays with his legs he s still a very respectable player in this league and we have a ton of respect for them pretty standard fare so far but anderson didn t stop there and that s when things exited reality and ventured elsewhere we know what to expect a little bit but herbert he s playing out of his mind he continued they have a really great solid offensive line as well and some really good running backs that can get downhill that can hit the perimeter it s going to be a good challenge for us anderson could have stopped at we have a ton of respect for them but continued into a fictional realm as a means of avoiding providing bulletin board material those who have watched herbert and the chargers the nfl s only winless team know the quarterback hasn t played well and neither have his teammates one might wonder whether out of his mind meant herbert was playing without the full scope of his faculties his touchdown to interception ratio 5 10 would match such a description perhaps we should just let last week s opponent the los angeles rams quentin lake summarize what has actually occurred he was throwing deli meat out there lake said during an appearance on the st brown podcast he s seeing ghosts i don t know what s going on but we knew we were going to get a couple of interceptions at least one the rams ended up snagging two with lake grabbing the first midway through the first quarter by sliding underneath herbert s intended target for one of the easier takeaways he ll log in his professional career fellow rams defensive back trent mcduffie hauled in the other in a 24 9 win over the chargers look herbert is deeply mired in the roughest stretch of his pro career while playing in an offense that clearly doesn t fit the chargers strengths offensive coordinator mike mcdaniel remains employed in los angeles but for how long remains to be seen if coach jim harbaugh is looking for a fall guy amid this disastrous season mcdaniel makes for an easy mark that s what makes anderson s comments baffling los angeles owns the nfl s 28th ranked offense in yards per game 26th in passing yards per game and 31st in interception rate the operation is a mess and herbert can t stop making things worse at least anderson achieved one goal he didn t give the chargers additional motivational material judging by what s happened up to this point in the season though it s unlikely he ll match the edge rusher s description sunday it might just be part of anderson s grand plan to soften up his next target
